The Price of Ingenuity#001.src: Previously implemented locomotive models employ an engine with relatively low efficiency.
The Price of Ingenuity#001.dst: Los modelos de locomotora empleados hasta ahora montan un motor de eficiencia relativamente baja.

The Price of Ingenuity#002.src: Rest for the night in you room in the Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#002.dst: Descansa durante la noche en tu habitación de la Pluma de Acero en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#003.src: ...what. Where is it? W-where is it?!
The Price of Ingenuity#003.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#005.src: My bow, Yuman! Where is it? WHERE did you put it?!
The Price of Ingenuity#005.dst: ¡Mi arco, Yuman! ¿Dónde está? ¡¿DÓNDE lo has puesto?!
The Price of Ingenuity#005.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#006.src: Hey, hey, relax, jeez! It's over here, on the meeting table! It fell off your bed in the early morning, so I figured I'd put it somewhere safe!
The Price of Ingenuity#006.dst: ¡Eh, eh, tranqui, jolín! ¡Está aquí, en la mesa de reuniones! Se te cayó de la cama de madrugada, ¡así que lo puse a buen recaudo!
The Price of Ingenuity#006.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#007.src: I didn't, like, snatch it off ya or anything! Sorry, man! My bad. I forgot you got like this.
The Price of Ingenuity#007.dst: ¡Que no te lo quité ni nada, tío! ¡Perdona! Culpa mía. Olvidé que te pones así.
The Price of Ingenuity#007.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#009.src: Sorry. For shouting at you. I... don't know what came over me.
The Price of Ingenuity#009.dst: Perdona. Por gritarte. No... no sé qué me ha pasado.
The Price of Ingenuity#009.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#010.src: Hey, it's all good! I get grouchy too when one of my bros moves my stuff without tellin' me! 'Kay, well, maybe not that grouchy, but- I sorta get it, is what I mean.
The Price of Ingenuity#010.dst: ¡Eh, no pasa nada! ¡Yo también me mosqueo cuando uno de mis hermanos me toca las cosas sin avisar! Bueno, vale, quizá no tanto, pero- lo pillo, más o menos, eso quiero decir.
The Price of Ingenuity#010.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#011.src: Mmh. Did I ever tell you about it back when I was staying here?
The Price of Ingenuity#011.dst: Mmh. ¿Te hablé de él alguna vez, cuando vivía aquí?
The Price of Ingenuity#011.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#012.src: Nah, don't think you ever did. You were still keepin' everyone an arm's length away back then, so I didn't want to push my luck.
The Price of Ingenuity#012.dst: Nah, creo que nunca. Por entonces aún mantenías a todo el mundo a distancia, así que no quise tentar a la suerte.
The Price of Ingenuity#012.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#013.src: Right... right. It's not even that big of a deal. My bow's just... important to me.
The Price of Ingenuity#013.dst: Ya... ya. Tampoco es para tanto. Es que mi arco es... importante para mí.
The Price of Ingenuity#013.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#014.src: Yes, I know I look silly walking around with the bulky thing all day! But I can't afford to lose it. I need it. I can't explain why, but I do.
The Price of Ingenuity#014.dst: ¡Sí, ya sé que hago el tonto paseándome todo el día con este trasto! Pero no puedo perderlo. Lo necesito. No sé explicar por qué, pero lo necesito.
The Price of Ingenuity#014.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#015.src: Nah that's cool, man! If we're talkin' silly, just take a look at me! I fight using my GUITAR! How d'you get sillier than that?
The Price of Ingenuity#015.dst: ¡Nah, si no pasa nada, tío! ¡Si hablamos de hacer el tonto, mírame a mí! ¡Yo peleo con mi GUITARRA! ¿Hay algo más tonto?
The Price of Ingenuity#015.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#016.src: Pff, ha! What, do you just play bad music until your enemies give up? "Please, stop, I can't bear it! The melody's too discordant!"
The Price of Ingenuity#016.dst: ¡Pff, ja! ¿Qué, tocas mal hasta que tus enemigos se rinden? "¡Para, por favor, no lo soporto! ¡La melodía desafina demasiado!"
The Price of Ingenuity#016.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#017.src: Hahahah! That'd be fun, I should try that! But nah, I just club 'em with it. Yus stuck some metal plates in, so it hurts more and doesn't break!
The Price of Ingenuity#017.dst: ¡Jajaja! Sería divertido, ¡tengo que probarlo! Pero no, solo les atizo con ella. Yus le metió unas placas de metal: duele más y no se rompe.
The Price of Ingenuity#017.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#018.src: Wow. You're right, that's way sillier than what I do. I've got to tell Zeph about this.
The Price of Ingenuity#018.dst: Vaya. Tienes razón, eso es mucho más tonto que lo mío. Tengo que contárselo a Zeph.
The Price of Ingenuity#018.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#019.src: Woah, hey! You don't gotta do that, let him think I'm cool! But, uh, jokes aside. Feeling better?
The Price of Ingenuity#019.dst: ¡Uy, eh! ¡No hace falta, deja que me vea guay! Pero, eh, bromas aparte. ¿Estás mejor?
The Price of Ingenuity#019.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#021.src: Good! Cool, then you should wake up the rest of your gang. Quill said he'd be over soon, wanted to talk to you about something.
The Price of Ingenuity#021.dst: ¡Bien! Guay, pues despierta al resto de tu pandilla. Quill dijo que vendría pronto, quería hablaros de algo.
The Price of Ingenuity#021.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#022.src: Wake up the other three members at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#022.dst: Despierta a los otros tres miembros en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#025.src: Morning, Sui! She's not exactly a... morning person. Guess I forgot to warn you!
The Price of Ingenuity#025.dst: ¡Buenos días, Sui! No es precisamente... madrugadora. ¡Creo que olvidé avisarte!
The Price of Ingenuity#025.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#029.src: Why'd you wake me up? Um, this early.
The Price of Ingenuity#029.dst: ¿Por qué me despiertas? Eh, tan pronto.
The Price of Ingenuity#029.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#031.src: Um... is he... expecting me to, ha, prepare, breakfast? Oh, no...
The Price of Ingenuity#031.dst: Eh... ¿es que... espera que yo, ja, prepare, el desayuno? Ay, no...
The Price of Ingenuity#031.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#033.src: And there she goes. Well, no stopping her anxieties now! Might as well just let her get it out of her system.
The Price of Ingenuity#033.dst: Y ahí va otra vez. ¡Ya no hay quien pare su ansiedad! Mejor dejar que lo suelte todo.
The Price of Ingenuity#033.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#035.src: Ah, yes, I had overheard! I assume he has some work for us then.
The Price of Ingenuity#035.dst: ¡Ah, sí, lo había oído! Supongo que tiene trabajo para nosotros.
The Price of Ingenuity#035.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#036.src: Allow me to go freshen up, and then I will join you.
The Price of Ingenuity#036.dst: Dejadme asearme un momento y enseguida me uno a vosotros.
The Price of Ingenuity#036.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#038.src: Surprisingly so, yes! These beds were much more comfortable than I had anticipated...
The Price of Ingenuity#038.dst: ¡Sorprendentemente, sí! Estas camas eran mucho más cómodas de lo que esperaba...
The Price of Ingenuity#038.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#039.src: However... hm. I appear to have been afflicted with repeating night terrors.
The Price of Ingenuity#039.dst: Aunque... hm. Parece que me aquejan terrores nocturnos recurrentes.
The Price of Ingenuity#039.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#040.src: Reality is setting in, in a sense. Returning to the {p} now is out of the question. We cannot come home until the deed is done.
The Price of Ingenuity#040.dst: La realidad se impone, en cierto modo. Volver a {p} ahora es impensable. No podemos regresar a casa hasta que el asunto esté resuelto.
The Price of Ingenuity#040.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#041.src: It does weigh on me a little. We have made new friends and allies here, but this is the furthest away I have ever been from home.
The Price of Ingenuity#041.dst: Sí que me pesa un poco. Aquí hemos hecho nuevos amigos y aliados, pero nunca había estado tan lejos de casa.
The Price of Ingenuity#041.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#042.src: Hm. I know the feeling, Mora. If it helps, it never really goes away, but it becomes... lighter. Easier to deal with.
The Price of Ingenuity#042.dst: Hm. Conozco esa sensación, Mora. Si te sirve: nunca se va del todo, pero se vuelve... más ligera. Más llevadera.
The Price of Ingenuity#042.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#043.src: Hoho! It does not especially, no. But I appreciate the sentiment. I am glad to have my family here with me.
The Price of Ingenuity#043.dst: ¡Jojo! No especialmente, no. Pero te agradezco el gesto. Me alegra tener aquí a mi familia.
The Price of Ingenuity#043.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#044.src: But enough of that! I heard Quill was coming over? I had best freshen up before he arrives. I will join the rest of you later.
The Price of Ingenuity#044.dst: ¡Pero basta de eso! ¿He oído que venía Quill? Será mejor que me asee antes de que llegue. Me uniré a vosotros más tarde.
The Price of Ingenuity#044.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#046.src: Hrrk..... f-f-five more minutes, m- s- Synd- Zzzzzzzzz.....
The Price of Ingenuity#046.dst: Hrrk..... c-c-cinco minutos más, m- S- Synd- Zzzzzzzzz.....
The Price of Ingenuity#046.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#048.src: Okay, he's slept enough. What do you think, should I shoot him?
The Price of Ingenuity#048.dst: Vale, ya ha dormido bastante. ¿Tú qué dices, le disparo?
The Price of Ingenuity#048.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#049.src: Pfft! Ha, kidding. It wouldn't work anyway, he's stubborn enough to just roll over and keep sleeping.
The Price of Ingenuity#049.dst: ¡Pfft! Ja, es broma. Tampoco funcionaría: es tan cabezota que se daría la vuelta y seguiría durmiendo.
The Price of Ingenuity#049.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#050.src: Hm, what can we try... oh, I know.
The Price of Ingenuity#050.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#051.src: Oh, wow, these sure are some nice shiny and rare trinkets! Gosh, if only Zeph were awake, he'd love these. What a shame!
The Price of Ingenuity#051.dst: Oh, vaya, ¡qué baratijas más brillantes y raras! Jo, si Zeph estuviera despierto le encantarían. ¡Qué pena!
The Price of Ingenuity#051.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#052.src: This is a fun one! It's a passion project, inspired by one of my favorite books, an intriguing story of a girl and her friends saving the world.
The Price of Ingenuity#052.dst: ¡Esta es divertida! Un proyecto personal inspirado en uno de mis libros favoritos: la intrigante historia de una chica y sus amigos que salvan el mundo.

The Price of Ingenuity#053.src: Oh, wow, these sure are some nice and shiny and rare trinkets! Gosh, if only Zeph were awake, he'd love these. What a shame!
The Price of Ingenuity#053.dst: Oh, vaya, ¡qué baratijas más bonitas, brillantes y raras! Jo, si Zeph estuviera despierto le encantarían. ¡Qué pena!
The Price of Ingenuity#053.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#054.src: HUH! N-no, wait, I- I- I'm awake, where are- sh-sh-show me the t-trinkets, I want to see-
The Price of Ingenuity#054.dst: ¡¿EH?! N-no, espera, y- y- ya estoy despierto, ¿dónde-? E-e-enséñame las b-baratijas, quiero verlas-
The Price of Ingenuity#054.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#056.src: There aren't an-any tr-trinkets, are there.
The Price of Ingenuity#056.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#057.src: Nope! But I like the enthusiasm.
The Price of Ingenuity#057.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#058.src: Ugh... wh-why are you w-waking everyone up, anyway? I d-didn't think we had an-anything planned today..
The Price of Ingenuity#058.dst: Uf... ¿p-por qué despiertas a t-todos, en serio? N-no creía que tuviéramos n-nada planeado hoy...
The Price of Ingenuity#058.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#060.src: O-oh! Uh... I- I- I- I slept... fine. G-g-good, even! Yeah!
The Price of Ingenuity#060.dst: ¡A-ah! Eh... y- y- y- yo dormí... bien. ¡M-m-muy bien, incluso! ¡Sí!
The Price of Ingenuity#060.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#062.src: H-hey! What's that s-s-supposed to mean!?
The Price of Ingenuity#062.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#063.src: You got in bed super late! And you know how I know that? Because your snoring only started waking me up after that!
The Price of Ingenuity#063.dst: ¡Te acostaste tardísimo! ¿Y sabes cómo lo sé? ¡Porque tus ronquidos empezaron a despertarme justo después!
The Price of Ingenuity#063.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#064.src: I kept waking up thinking it was thundering outside, that's how loud it was!
The Price of Ingenuity#064.dst: ¡Me despertaba pensando que había tormenta fuera, así de fuerte era!
The Price of Ingenuity#064.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#065.src: Wh-what?! N-n-no, that's not- {u}, b-back me up here! I- I wasn't sn-snoring loudly, right?
The Price of Ingenuity#065.dst: ¡¿Q-qué?! N-n-no, eso no es- {u}, ¡a-apóyame! Yo- yo no r-roncaba tan fuerte, ¿verdad?
The Price of Ingenuity#065.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#066.src: S-see! It couldn't have been th-that bad.
The Price of Ingenuity#066.dst: ¡L-lo ves! No pudo ser t-tan grave.
The Price of Ingenuity#066.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#067.src: Or maybe {u} needs to sleep lighter! Next thing you know, an enemy's gonna sneak up on you at night, and you're not gonna hear it because you're too used to Zeph's loud snoring!
The Price of Ingenuity#067.dst: ¡O quizá {u} debería tener el sueño más ligero! Cualquier noche se te acerca un enemigo y no lo oyes, ¡porque estás demasiado acostumbrado a los ronquidos de Zeph!
The Price of Ingenuity#067.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#068.src: Oh my g-gods... the whole station m-must have heard me!
The Price of Ingenuity#068.dst: Por los d-dioses... ¡toda la estación m-me habrá oído!
The Price of Ingenuity#068.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#069.src: It better have been just the station! Next thing you know, the crown's going to raid this hideout, and they would've only found it because your snoring echoes around {p} every night!
The Price of Ingenuity#069.dst: ¡Ojalá solo la estación! Cualquier día la Corona asalta este escondite, ¡y lo habrán encontrado solo porque tus ronquidos resuenan por {p} cada noche!
The Price of Ingenuity#069.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#071.src: Oh! W-wonder what it's about. Do you-
The Price of Ingenuity#071.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#072.src: Do you think h-he's mad about my mistake?
The Price of Ingenuity#072.dst: ¿Creéis que está enfadado por mi e-error?
The Price of Ingenuity#072.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#073.src: You heard him yourself, stupid. He wasn't mad! He thinks you did the right thing!
The Price of Ingenuity#073.dst: Lo oíste tú mismo, tonto. ¡No estaba enfadado! ¡Cree que hiciste lo correcto!
The Price of Ingenuity#073.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#074.src: B-but... Still! Ugh. I'll have to go freshen up b-before he's here then!
The Price of Ingenuity#074.dst: P-pero... ¡Aun así! Uf. ¡Entonces tendré que asearme a-antes de que llegue!
The Price of Ingenuity#074.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#075.src: And that leaves one more. Hm...
The Price of Ingenuity#075.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#076.src: {u}, you should let me wake her.
The Price of Ingenuity#076.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#077.src: She's... kind of like Sui, but more intense? In the way she's, y'know. Military trained.
The Price of Ingenuity#077.dst: Es... como Sui, pero más intensa. Ya sabes, por lo de... la instrucción militar.
The Price of Ingenuity#077.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#078.src: So it's probably better if I do it since I know what I'm dealing with!
The Price of Ingenuity#078.dst: ¡Así que mejor lo hago yo, que sé a lo que me enfrento!
The Price of Ingenuity#078.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#080.src: You know, you'd think she'd wake up at the crack of dawn with her military background... but nope.
The Price of Ingenuity#080.dst: Con su pasado militar pensarías que se levanta al amanecer... pues no.
The Price of Ingenuity#080.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#084.src: I thought I'd be prepared for it, but nope...
The Price of Ingenuity#084.dst: Creía que estaba preparada, pero no...
The Price of Ingenuity#084.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#085.src: We thought you were asleep, Syndra! I was coming up to wake you!
The Price of Ingenuity#085.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#086.src: Well... I'm awake. Quill is stopping by, right?
The Price of Ingenuity#086.dst: Bueno... estoy despierta. Quill va a pasarse, ¿no?
The Price of Ingenuity#086.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#088.src: I've been awake for a while, Rex. I heard you talking about it downstairs!
The Price of Ingenuity#088.dst: Llevo un rato despierta, Rex. ¡Os he oído hablarlo abajo!
The Price of Ingenuity#088.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#089.src: And here I thought I was a morning person...
The Price of Ingenuity#089.dst: Y yo que me creía madrugadora...
The Price of Ingenuity#089.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#091.src: Ah, hello! Good morning to you all.
The Price of Ingenuity#091.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#093.src: Oh, dear. What is with all the formality this morning?
The Price of Ingenuity#093.dst: Vaya por dios. ¿A qué viene tanta formalidad esta mañana?
The Price of Ingenuity#093.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#094.src: Well, Yuman told us to be up and ready since you were coming-
The Price of Ingenuity#094.dst: Bueno, Yuman nos dijo que estuviéramos listos porque venía usted-
The Price of Ingenuity#094.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#095.src: -so, naturally, the assumption was made that you had a mission for us-
The Price of Ingenuity#095.dst: -así que, naturalmente, supusimos que tenía una misión para nosotros-
The Price of Ingenuity#095.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#096.src: -o-o-or that w-we had done something wrong...
The Price of Ingenuity#096.dst: -o- o- o que h-habíamos hecho algo mal...
The Price of Ingenuity#096.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#098.src: Pahaha! Goodness, that was a lot all at once. Syndra, are they typically like this?
The Price of Ingenuity#098.dst: ¡Pajaja! Madre mía, todo de golpe. Syndra, ¿siempre son así?
The Price of Ingenuity#098.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#099.src: They're not usually this snappy, no. But between meeting the brothers and experiencing the Roughworks, they're probably getting swept up in their emotions.
The Price of Ingenuity#099.dst: No suelen estar tan alterados, no. Pero entre conocer a los hermanos y vivir lo de Roughworks, se estarán dejando llevar por las emociones.
The Price of Ingenuity#099.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#100.src: Ah... I understand, don't worry. But no, I'm not here to assign you all a mission, nor to scold you, or anything else of the sort.
The Price of Ingenuity#100.dst: Ah... lo entiendo, no os preocupéis. Pero no, no vengo a encargaros una misión, ni a regañaros, ni nada por el estilo.
The Price of Ingenuity#100.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#101.src: I simply wanted to offer you all a starting sum of tickets for the shops. I'd meant to give them yesterday, but in the chaos I forgot to.
The Price of Ingenuity#101.dst: Solo quería daros una suma inicial de vales para las tiendas. Pensaba dároslos ayer, pero con el caos se me olvidó.
The Price of Ingenuity#101.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#102.src: The ticket system is used to ration out food and other items to people that need it. You'll receive a weekly allowance of tickets to spend on whatever you'd like, in addition to this starting sum.
The Price of Ingenuity#102.dst: El sistema de vales sirve para racionar comida y otros artículos entre quienes los necesitan. Además de esta suma inicial, recibiréis vales cada semana para gastarlos en lo que queráis.
The Price of Ingenuity#102.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#103.src: Of course, basic amenities are free of charge if you're part of our community. Wouldn't want any of our members to sleep on the tracks, after all!
The Price of Ingenuity#103.dst: Claro que los servicios básicos son gratuitos si formas parte de nuestra comunidad. ¡No querríamos que ningún miembro durmiera en las vías!
The Price of Ingenuity#103.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#104.src: So... I baked bread for, um, no reason?
The Price of Ingenuity#104.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#105.src: I fear so, haha! Do not worry, you will not be forced to do work here.
The Price of Ingenuity#105.dst: ¡Me temo que sí, jaja! Tranquila, aquí nadie te obligará a trabajar.
The Price of Ingenuity#105.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#106.src: And, besides, if I wanted you to cook for us, I would have let you know well in advance.
The Price of Ingenuity#106.dst: Y, además, si quisiera que cocinaras para nosotros, te lo habría dicho con mucha antelación.
The Price of Ingenuity#106.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#107.src: I mean... I w-wouldn't mind some fr-fresh bread...
The Price of Ingenuity#107.dst: Bueno... a mí no me i-importaría un poco de pan r-recién hecho...
The Price of Ingenuity#107.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#109.src: Ah, one more thing. I wanted to point you all towards the training yard- Zeph, I believe you have been there already?
The Price of Ingenuity#109.dst: Ah, una cosa más. Quería indicaros el patio de entrenamiento- Zeph, ¿tú ya has estado allí?
The Price of Ingenuity#109.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#111.src: I believe the brothers should be there right now. If you're to be working with us, it would be best to get used to each other's fighting styles.
The Price of Ingenuity#111.dst: Creo que los hermanos estarán allí ahora mismo. Si vais a trabajar con nosotros, conviene acostumbrarse al estilo de lucha de cada uno.
The Price of Ingenuity#111.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#112.src: Why don't you go join them there, while Syndra and I discuss further matters?
The Price of Ingenuity#112.dst: ¿Por qué no os unís a ellos mientras Syndra y yo hablamos de otros asuntos?
The Price of Ingenuity#112.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#113.src: Find the brothers at the training yard at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#113.dst: Busca a los hermanos en el patio de entrenamiento en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#114.src: ...do you really gotta head out there again?
The Price of Ingenuity#114.dst: ...¿de verdad tienes que salir otra vez?
The Price of Ingenuity#114.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#115.src: You know contracts are rare, man. I have to take what I can get.
The Price of Ingenuity#115.dst: Los contratos escasean, tío. Tengo que coger lo que salga.
The Price of Ingenuity#115.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#116.src: Why's it always gotta be you and Yus heading out?! For once- for once, man, take care of yourself!
The Price of Ingenuity#116.dst: ¡¿Por qué siempre tenéis que ir tú y Yus?! ¡Por una vez- por una vez, tío, cuídate tú!
The Price of Ingenuity#116.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#120.src: No, this can wait. Did Quill send you over?
The Price of Ingenuity#120.dst: No, esto puede esperar. ¿Os manda Quill?
The Price of Ingenuity#120.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#121.src: Indeed he did. He suggested we get to know each other's fighting styles!
The Price of Ingenuity#121.dst: Así es. ¡Nos sugirió conocer el estilo de lucha de cada uno!
The Price of Ingenuity#121.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#122.src: Not a bad idea. Yuman and I would be happy to show off what we can do, right?
The Price of Ingenuity#122.dst: No es mala idea. Yuman y yo estaremos encantados de enseñar lo que sabemos hacer, ¿verdad?
The Price of Ingenuity#122.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#124.src: Well, Zeph, {u}, and I've already been through it! Some cool moves from you both! Man, getting to see a cursed one in action was awesome...
The Price of Ingenuity#124.dst: ¡Bueno, Zeph, {u} y yo ya hemos pasado por eso! ¡Buenos movimientos los de los dos! Tío, ver a un maldito en acción fue increíble...
The Price of Ingenuity#124.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#126.src: Yeah! Like, I'd hear all the stories, and think... man, having those kinds of powers sounds so cool. Sometimes I wished I could have em! Without, uh, being evil, of course.
The Price of Ingenuity#126.dst: ¡Sí! O sea, oía todas esas historias y pensaba... tío, tener esos poderes suena genial. ¡A veces deseaba tenerlos! Sin, eh, ser malvado, claro.
The Price of Ingenuity#126.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#127.src: You'd be even harder to deal with if you did, bro. But on that subject- Quill said something about you all practicing... what was the word he used... "magic?"
The Price of Ingenuity#127.dst: Si los tuvieras serías aún más insoportable, hermano. Pero a eso iba- Quill dijo algo de que practicáis... ¿cómo era la palabra...? ¿"magia"?
The Price of Ingenuity#127.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#128.src: What?! Ey, princess, why didn't you show anything off the other day?
The Price of Ingenuity#128.dst: ¡¿Qué?! Eh, princesa, ¿por qué no enseñaste nada el otro día?
The Price of Ingenuity#128.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#130.src: Don't be insensitive, Yuman. It isn't something people just... pick up.
The Price of Ingenuity#130.dst: No seas insensible, Yuman. No es algo que la gente... aprenda sin más.
The Price of Ingenuity#130.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#131.src: From what little I've heard from Quill, it can take years of study to master a blessing... so I wouldn't be surprised if they couldn't even make a spark! Uh, no offense.
The Price of Ingenuity#131.dst: Por lo poco que le he oído a Quill, dominar una bendición puede llevar años de estudio... ¡así que no me sorprendería que no sacaran ni una chispa! Eh, sin ofender.
The Price of Ingenuity#131.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#132.src: W- well... maybe we'll s- sur- surprise you!
The Price of Ingenuity#132.dst: B- bueno... ¡a lo mejor os s- sor- sorprendemos!
The Price of Ingenuity#132.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#133.src: Ha, think you're the only ones with hidden talents? I've got a trick or two up my sleeve too!
The Price of Ingenuity#133.dst: Ja, ¿creéis que solo vosotros tenéis talentos ocultos? ¡Yo también me guardo algún truco en la manga!
The Price of Ingenuity#133.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#135.src: It's an expression, dumbass. Like you're one to talk. Why are you half-naked?
The Price of Ingenuity#135.dst: Es una expresión, idiota. Mira quién habla. ¿Por qué vas medio desnudo?
The Price of Ingenuity#135.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#136.src: To show off my abs? Obviously. Anyway, {u}, why don't you decide who goes first?
The Price of Ingenuity#136.dst: ¿Para lucir abdominales? Obvio. En fin, {u}, ¿por qué no decides tú quién va primero?
The Price of Ingenuity#136.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#138.src: Who, me? Sorry, but I'll sit this one out until you're all done.
The Price of Ingenuity#138.dst: ¿Quién, yo? Lo siento, yo me quedo fuera hasta que acabéis todos.
The Price of Ingenuity#138.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#139.src: Got to save the best for last, right? Heh.
The Price of Ingenuity#139.dst: Lo mejor se guarda para el final, ¿no? Je.
The Price of Ingenuity#139.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#140.src: I'll have to add arrows until my bowstring runs out of space next time...
The Price of Ingenuity#140.dst: La próxima vez tendré que poner flechas hasta llenar la cuerda...
The Price of Ingenuity#140.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#141.src: I'll h-have to come back here a-again tonight!
The Price of Ingenuity#141.dst: ¡T-tendré que volver aquí o-otra vez esta noche!
The Price of Ingenuity#141.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#142.src: It's like there's ripples gently spreading within me...
The Price of Ingenuity#142.dst: Es como si dentro de mí se extendieran ondas suaves...
The Price of Ingenuity#142.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#143.src: To see my powers growing this clearly...
The Price of Ingenuity#143.dst: Ver mi poder crecer con tanta claridad...
The Price of Ingenuity#143.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#145.src: Dang, I think I overloaded it. I'll have to put it through a charge cycle...
The Price of Ingenuity#145.dst: Vaya, creo que lo he sobrecargado. Tendré que darle un ciclo de carga...
The Price of Ingenuity#145.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#147.src: So. Magic, curses, blessings... whatever you want to call it, it hasn't worked for me. It just doesn't... click.
The Price of Ingenuity#147.dst: Bueno. Magia, maldiciones, bendiciones... llámalo como quieras, conmigo no ha funcionado. Simplemente no... encaja.
The Price of Ingenuity#147.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#148.src: Ah, not to worry, Rex! Even without it, none in the province could match your accuracy with a bow.
The Price of Ingenuity#148.dst: ¡Ah, no te preocupes, Rex! Aun sin ella, nadie en la provincia igualaría tu puntería con el arco.
The Price of Ingenuity#148.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#149.src: Y- yeah! And if you d- did get magic, it'd j- jus- just be unfair for the rest of us!
The Price of Ingenuity#149.dst: ¡S- sí! Y si t- tuvieras magia, s- se- ¡sería injusto para los demás!
The Price of Ingenuity#149.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#150.src: Yeah, yeah, sure. Either way, I've been practicing a new technique... let's see if I can pull it off.
The Price of Ingenuity#150.dst: Ya, ya, claro. Sea como sea, llevo practicando una técnica nueva... a ver si me sale.
The Price of Ingenuity#150.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#152.src: Yep! I just place every arrow on the string at once, which lets me shoot at a much larger area!
The Price of Ingenuity#152.dst: ¡Sip! ¡Solo pongo todas las flechas en la cuerda a la vez, y así cubro un área mucho mayor!
The Price of Ingenuity#152.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#153.src: But... how'd you manage to hit each arrow right on target?! That's... insane!
The Price of Ingenuity#153.dst: Pero... ¡¿cómo has clavado cada flecha en el blanco?! Eso es... ¡una locura!
The Price of Ingenuity#153.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#154.src: Ha. Go on, keep praising my skill. That was actually the first time I tried that many arrows at once... glad it worked out!
The Price of Ingenuity#154.dst: Ja. Venga, sigue alabando mi técnica. En realidad era la primera vez que probaba con tantas flechas a la vez... ¡menos mal que salió bien!
The Price of Ingenuity#154.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#155.src: The... first... You said you'd practiced it, man! What do you mean that was the first time?!
The Price of Ingenuity#155.dst: La... primera... ¡Dijiste que la habías practicado, tía! ¡¿Cómo que era la primera vez?!
The Price of Ingenuity#155.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#156.src: Yeah? I practiced theoretically. In my head. Keep up, Yulie.
The Price of Ingenuity#156.dst: ¿Sí? La practiqué en teoría. En mi cabeza. Sigue el ritmo, Yulie.
The Price of Ingenuity#156.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#158.src: Couldn't even make a spark, eh?
The Price of Ingenuity#158.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#159.src: Alright, alright! I've been proven wrong.
The Price of Ingenuity#159.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#161.src: So... I w-want to first say that I've been c-coming here every night.
The Price of Ingenuity#161.dst: Bueno... p-primero quiero decir que he estado v-viniendo aquí cada noche.
The Price of Ingenuity#161.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#162.src: I was e-embarrassed that I just didn't g-get it.
The Price of Ingenuity#162.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#163.src: I mean, j-just look at how fast your m-magic developed, Mora!
The Price of Ingenuity#163.dst: O sea, ¡m-mira lo rápido que creció tu m-magia, Mora!
The Price of Ingenuity#163.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#164.src: And you, S-sui! You are a natural, a-after all.
The Price of Ingenuity#164.dst: ¡Y tú, S-sui! Si eres un t-talento natural.
The Price of Ingenuity#164.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#165.src: I still don't know any form of magic. Why feel so embarrassed?
The Price of Ingenuity#165.dst: Yo sigo sin saber ninguna clase de magia. ¿Por qué avergonzarse?
The Price of Ingenuity#165.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#166.src: Rex, you don't even n-need magic to be a valuable asset! You're the best archer in the w-world!
The Price of Ingenuity#166.dst: Rex, ¡tú no n-necesitas magia para ser valiosa! ¡Eres la mejor arquera del m-mundo!
The Price of Ingenuity#166.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#167.src: I don't h-have that skill! My blade skills a-aren't good enough! You've h-had to save me time and time a-again.
The Price of Ingenuity#167.dst: ¡Yo no t-tengo ese talento! ¡Mi manejo de la espada no es s-suficiente! Has t-tenido que salvarme una y otra v-vez.
The Price of Ingenuity#167.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#168.src: And {u}, I felt like I had l-let you down after all the k-knowledge you had given me.
The Price of Ingenuity#168.dst: Y {u}, sentía que te había f-fallado después de todo lo que me has e-enseñado.
The Price of Ingenuity#168.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#169.src: I may not have talked to you a lot, Zeph. But from what I know of the science behind magic, you don't have to blame yourself for not getting it.
The Price of Ingenuity#169.dst: No hemos hablado mucho, Zeph. Pero por lo que sé de la ciencia que hay tras la magia, no tienes que culparte por no pillarlo.
The Price of Ingenuity#169.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#170.src: A lot of people study magic their whole lives. I'm sure you'll get there eventually.
The Price of Ingenuity#170.dst: Mucha gente estudia magia toda su vida. Seguro que acabas llegando.
The Price of Ingenuity#170.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#171.src: Thank y-you, Yusanu. However, I think I f-finally figured it out...
The Price of Ingenuity#171.dst: G-gracias, Yusanu. Aunque creo que p-por fin lo he entendido...
The Price of Ingenuity#171.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#173.src: I think I'm finally g-getting this magic thing somewhat down!
The Price of Ingenuity#173.dst: ¡Creo que por fin le voy c-cogiendo el truco a esto de la magia!
The Price of Ingenuity#173.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#174.src: I will n-not stop practicing! N-not until I can m-m-match you all!
The Price of Ingenuity#174.dst: ¡N-no pienso dejar de practicar! ¡N-no hasta que pueda i-i-igualaros!
The Price of Ingenuity#174.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#176.src: Come on, man! Show us what you've got!
The Price of Ingenuity#176.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#177.src: ...okay. I've tried to, um, practice a bit, now that I'm... yeah.
The Price of Ingenuity#177.dst: ...vale. He intentado, eh, practicar un poco, ahora que soy... sí.
The Price of Ingenuity#177.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#178.src: I haven't fully developed it, but, I have this new skill...
The Price of Ingenuity#178.dst: No lo tengo del todo desarrollado, pero tengo esta habilidad nueva...
The Price of Ingenuity#178.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#179.src: Okay! I'm going to try it!
The Price of Ingenuity#179.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#180.src: W- woah! It's like you ma- made that out of n- n- nothing!
The Price of Ingenuity#180.dst: ¡A- anda! ¡Es como si lo hu- hubieras hecho de la n- n- nada!
The Price of Ingenuity#180.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#181.src: ...ugh! It takes so much concentration... even a word makes me fail...
The Price of Ingenuity#181.dst: ...¡uf! Requiere muchísima concentración... una palabra y ya fallo...
The Price of Ingenuity#181.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#182.src: Also. It's not, um, out of nothing.
The Price of Ingenuity#182.dst: Y además. No es, eh, de la nada.
The Price of Ingenuity#182.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#183.src: It's like... there's an ocean of swirling energy, all around me. If I can get a bit, in, like... a bucket, I can use it. But... I don't know how to get it without, um, falling into it and getting overwhelmed.
The Price of Ingenuity#183.dst: Es como... hay un océano de energía en remolino a mi alrededor. Si logro coger un poco, como en... un cubo, puedo usarla. Pero... no sé cómo cogerla sin, eh, caerme dentro y quedar desbordada.
The Price of Ingenuity#183.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#185.src: Uh... n- not- not really, but-
The Price of Ingenuity#185.dst: Eh... n- no- no mucho, pero-
The Price of Ingenuity#185.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#190.src: I... I'm fine. No, even... more than that...
The Price of Ingenuity#190.dst: Yo... estoy bien. No, incluso... más que eso...
The Price of Ingenuity#190.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#191.src: It's like... I finally felt this power's ebb and flow, not just... it pouring out, I...
The Price of Ingenuity#191.dst: Es como... por fin he sentido el flujo y reflujo de este poder, no solo... cómo se derrama, yo...
The Price of Ingenuity#191.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#192.src: ...ah! Is everyone fine? You... you all seem fine. Okay...
The Price of Ingenuity#192.dst: ...¡ah! ¿Estáis todos bien? Parecéis... parecéis estar bien. Vale...
The Price of Ingenuity#192.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#193.src: I think... I think that's all from me.
The Price of Ingenuity#193.dst: Creo... creo que ya está todo.
The Price of Ingenuity#193.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#194.src: Very well! This is as good an opportunity as any to show off my progress!
The Price of Ingenuity#194.dst: ¡Muy bien! ¡No hay mejor ocasión para lucir mis progresos!
The Price of Ingenuity#194.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#195.src: Although I am proficient in combat with my hammer, that is... standard. So, allow me to show my magic instead, as that is what I have been training!
The Price of Ingenuity#195.dst: Aunque manejo el martillo con soltura, eso es... lo habitual. ¡Así que permitidme mostrar mi magia, que es lo que he estado entrenando!
The Price of Ingenuity#195.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#196.src: ...oh, dear. I did not expect it to have become so powerful! It seems I must still master control over it...
The Price of Ingenuity#196.dst: ...ay, madre. ¡No esperaba que se hubiera vuelto tan poderosa! Parece que aún debo dominar su control...
The Price of Ingenuity#196.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#197.src: I apologize for the damage I have caused. If you would ask for compensation, I would gladly provide it.
The Price of Ingenuity#197.dst: Pido disculpas por los daños que he causado. Si pedís una compensación, la pagaré con gusto.
The Price of Ingenuity#197.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#198.src: Eh, don't worry about it. It's just a training room. Besides, all this junk in here doesn't even work anymore.
The Price of Ingenuity#198.dst: Bah, no te preocupes. Es solo una sala de entrenamiento. Además, todos estos trastos ya no funcionaban.
The Price of Ingenuity#198.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#200.src: Yo, that was badass, man! Your curse is awesome.
The Price of Ingenuity#200.dst: ¡Yo, eso ha sido brutal, tío! Tu maldición es increíble.
The Price of Ingenuity#200.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#201.src: Is it! I suppose it is, haha! I am glad to have had the oppurtunity to learn to use it.
The Price of Ingenuity#201.dst: ¿Lo es? Supongo que sí, ¡jaja! Me alegra haber tenido la oportunidad de aprender a usarla.
The Price of Ingenuity#201.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#202.src: That is all, then. Who will go next?
The Price of Ingenuity#202.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#203.src: Lemme show you just what I can really do, man.
The Price of Ingenuity#203.dst: Deja que te enseñe lo que sé hacer de verdad, tío.
The Price of Ingenuity#203.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#204.src: Watch and learn, princess. Not every day you get to see me shred.
The Price of Ingenuity#204.dst: Mira y aprende, princesa. No todos los días me ves darle caña.
The Price of Ingenuity#204.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#207.src: My Sonic Boomer can help out with defense too! I'm no one trick pony - I can cover every genre of combat!
The Price of Ingenuity#207.dst: ¡Mi Estruendo Sónico también ayuda en defensa! No soy de un solo truco: ¡domino todos los géneros del combate!
The Price of Ingenuity#207.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#208.src: And bam! That's it from me and Sonic Boomer for today.
The Price of Ingenuity#208.dst: ¡Y pam! Eso es todo por hoy de mí y del Estruendo Sónico.
The Price of Ingenuity#208.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#211.src: I'll say, I'm not as... direct... as Yuman. But I can hold my own in a fight.
The Price of Ingenuity#211.dst: La verdad, no soy tan... directo... como Yuman. Pero me defiendo bien peleando.
The Price of Ingenuity#211.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#213.src: I mean... yeah? Yusanu made this thing for me, and he calls it the Electric Blaster.
The Price of Ingenuity#213.dst: Pues... ¿sí? Me lo hizo Yusanu, y lo llama el Bláster Eléctrico.
The Price of Ingenuity#213.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#214.src: It's also able to fire a much larger blast with way more power, but that does make it less... precise.
The Price of Ingenuity#214.dst: También puede disparar una descarga mucho más grande y potente, pero entonces es menos... preciso.
The Price of Ingenuity#214.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#215.src: That's all from me. Next one!
The Price of Ingenuity#215.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#216.src: Alrighty! Let's see... where to start...
The Price of Ingenuity#216.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#217.src: Oh, you have gotta be... again?! Really?! Ugh!
The Price of Ingenuity#217.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#218.src: Yulie, Yuman, can you check the tunnels for any intruders?
The Price of Ingenuity#218.dst: Yulie, Yuman, ¿podéis revisar los túneles por si hay intrusos?
The Price of Ingenuity#218.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#219.src: If you need us to. Keep us updated, would you?
The Price of Ingenuity#219.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#220.src: Sure. Get the others to help you, I gotta run and check on things!
The Price of Ingenuity#220.dst: Claro. Que los demás os ayuden, ¡tengo que ir corriendo a ver una cosa!
The Price of Ingenuity#220.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#221.src: Of course we can help, just tell us what to do!
The Price of Ingenuity#221.dst: ¡Claro que podemos ayudar, solo dinos qué hacer!
The Price of Ingenuity#221.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#222.src: {u} and I actually have some important tasks Syndra needed done!! Will you be okay without us?
The Price of Ingenuity#222.dst: ¡¡{u} y yo tenemos unas tareas importantes que Syndra nos encargó!! ¿Os las apañáis sin nosotros?
The Price of Ingenuity#222.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#223.src: We will. It shouldn't be too hard for us, anyway- just routine check ups.
The Price of Ingenuity#223.dst: Sí. Tampoco será difícil para nosotros- solo comprobaciones rutinarias.
The Price of Ingenuity#223.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#224.src: Yep, yep! Alright guys, follow papa!
The Price of Ingenuity#224.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#225.src: Wh- what? Ugh... put some c- cl- clothes on, a- at- at least.
The Price of Ingenuity#225.dst: ¿Q- qué? Uf... p- po- ponte algo de r- ropa, al m- menos.
The Price of Ingenuity#225.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#229.src: I needed a way to get everyone else out of here so we could talk!
The Price of Ingenuity#229.dst: ¡Necesitaba sacar a todos de aquí para que pudiéramos hablar!
The Price of Ingenuity#229.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#230.src: Yeah, obviously! It was the best excuse I could come up with in the moment.
The Price of Ingenuity#230.dst: ¡Sí, evidentemente! Fue la mejor excusa que se me ocurrió en el momento.
The Price of Ingenuity#230.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#231.src: So, look. Yusanu's been really hard to get a read of! He's barely ever around- I'm honestly surprised he even showed up today!
The Price of Ingenuity#231.dst: Mira. ¡A Yusanu cuesta muchísimo calarlo! Casi nunca está aquí- ¡sinceramente, me sorprende que hoy apareciera!
The Price of Ingenuity#231.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#232.src: But anyway, when you and Zeph headed out with Yuman during the last alarm, I wanted to check in with Yusanu and see what he was up to.
The Price of Ingenuity#232.dst: En fin, cuando tú y Zeph salisteis con Yuman durante la última alarma, quise pasarme por donde Yusanu a ver qué se traía entre manos.
The Price of Ingenuity#232.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#233.src: But guess what? He was gone! Walked into his workshop and never walked out. Isn't that weird?
The Price of Ingenuity#233.dst: ¿Y sabes qué? ¡No estaba! Entró en su taller y no volvió a salir. ¿No es raro?
The Price of Ingenuity#233.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#234.src: I don't know what it means, and I don't know if he's a risk to us or not. But what I do know is that he's suspicious!
The Price of Ingenuity#234.dst: No sé qué significa, ni sé si es un peligro para nosotros. ¡Pero lo que sí sé es que es sospechoso!
The Price of Ingenuity#234.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#235.src: Because they'd all probably tell me not to do anything impulsive right now. Which isn't even true, I've thought this plan out extensively!
The Price of Ingenuity#235.dst: Porque seguramente todos me dirían que no hiciera nada impulsivo ahora mismo. Lo cual ni siquiera es cierto, ¡me he pensado este plan a fondo!
The Price of Ingenuity#235.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#236.src: Come on, meet me outside his workshop! I just want to look. If it's nothing, then it's nothing! But I don't think it's nothing.
The Price of Ingenuity#236.dst: ¡Venga, nos vemos fuera de su taller! Solo quiero mirar. Si no es nada, ¡pues no es nada! Pero no creo que no sea nada.
The Price of Ingenuity#236.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#238.src: I'll meet up with you at the workshop.
The Price of Ingenuity#238.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#241.src: See? I told you! He's just... gone.
The Price of Ingenuity#241.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#242.src: Not even a trace... Seems like I wasn't distrustful for nothing. But how?
The Price of Ingenuity#242.dst: Ni rastro... Parece que no desconfiaba en balde. Pero ¿cómo?
The Price of Ingenuity#242.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#243.src: He has to have gone somewhere! He couldn't have just... vanished.
The Price of Ingenuity#243.dst: ¡Tiene que haber ido a alguna parte! No puede haberse... esfumado.
The Price of Ingenuity#243.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#244.src: There has to be something else going on here! Do you see why I suspect him now?
The Price of Ingenuity#244.dst: ¡Aquí pasa algo más! ¿Ahora entiendes por qué sospecho de él?
The Price of Ingenuity#244.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#245.src: Let's snoop around a bit and make sure he's not posing a threat to us.
The Price of Ingenuity#245.dst: Vamos a fisgar un poco y asegurarnos de que no nos amenaza.
The Price of Ingenuity#245.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#247.src: I'm glad you feel that way. Makes me feel less... horrible... about it.
The Price of Ingenuity#247.dst: Me alegra que pienses así. Hace que me sienta menos... horrible... por esto.
The Price of Ingenuity#247.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#248.src: I guess we can be horrible people together, then.
The Price of Ingenuity#248.dst: Supongo que podemos ser horribles juntos, entonces.
The Price of Ingenuity#248.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#249.src: I get it, trust me. They've taken us in and given us a place to stay, and now...
The Price of Ingenuity#249.dst: Lo entiendo, créeme. Nos han acogido y nos han dado un techo, y ahora...
The Price of Ingenuity#249.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#250.src: If we're wrong, if I'm wrong, then we both might get thrown out.
The Price of Ingenuity#250.dst: Si nos equivocamos, si me equivoco, puede que nos echen a los dos.
The Price of Ingenuity#250.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#251.src: The blame will land squarely on us both. I really hope that even if we are kicked out, the rest can still stay here...
The Price of Ingenuity#251.dst: La culpa recaerá de lleno sobre los dos. Espero de verdad que, aunque nos echen, los demás puedan quedarse...
The Price of Ingenuity#251.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#252.src: ...no time to dwell on that. He must have left the workshop through an exit somewhere. Let's look around and see what we can find.
The Price of Ingenuity#252.dst: ...no hay tiempo para darle vueltas. Habrá salido del taller por alguna salida. Vamos a mirar por ahí a ver qué encontramos.
The Price of Ingenuity#252.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#253.src: Try and find Yusanu in his workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#253.dst: Intenta encontrar a Yusanu en su taller en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#254.src: Aha! And you thought I was just being paranoid.
The Price of Ingenuity#254.dst: ¡Ajá! Y tú pensando que solo eran paranoias mías.
The Price of Ingenuity#254.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#255.src: But you were thinking it, I could tell!
The Price of Ingenuity#255.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#256.src: Okay, fine, maybe a little. But I was right to be!
The Price of Ingenuity#256.dst: Vale, bien, quizá un poco. ¡Pero hacía bien en sospechar!
The Price of Ingenuity#256.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#257.src: That's confirmation. Though, not like we needed it...
The Price of Ingenuity#257.dst: Ahí está la confirmación. Aunque tampoco nos hacía falta...
The Price of Ingenuity#257.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#260.src: Yusanu's really pulling out all the stops to make sure nobody follows him!
The Price of Ingenuity#260.dst: ¡Yusanu está echando el resto para que nadie le siga!
The Price of Ingenuity#260.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#261.src: Too bad we're persistent, though. There's got to be some way to open it, we just need to find it!
The Price of Ingenuity#261.dst: Lástima que seamos tan insistentes. Tiene que haber alguna forma de abrirla, ¡solo hay que encontrarla!
The Price of Ingenuity#261.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#262.src: Whatever you did seems to have worked, the door's open!
The Price of Ingenuity#262.dst: Lo que hayas hecho parece que ha funcionado, ¡la puerta está abierta!
The Price of Ingenuity#262.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#264.src: Dead end? No, I see something on the other side...
The Price of Ingenuity#264.dst: ¿Callejón sin salida? No, veo algo al otro lado...
The Price of Ingenuity#264.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#265.src: How do we get across? I guess you could try to use your magic... but I don't want you to put yourself at risk just cause I dragged you along for this.
The Price of Ingenuity#265.dst: ¿Cómo cruzamos? Supongo que podrías usar tu magia... pero no quiero que te arriesgues solo porque te he arrastrado hasta aquí.
The Price of Ingenuity#265.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#267.src: Oh! Yusanu has to have taken this way, there aren't any other options. So, there's a trick to it...
The Price of Ingenuity#267.dst: ¡Oh! Yusanu tuvo que pasar por aquí, no hay otra opción. Así que hay algún truco...
The Price of Ingenuity#267.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#268.src: Look, over there! Do you see the button on the other side? I bet he uses it to close off this path whenever he takes it.
The Price of Ingenuity#268.dst: ¡Mira, allí! ¿Ves el botón del otro lado? Seguro que lo usa para cerrar este paso cada vez que lo cruza.
The Price of Ingenuity#268.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#269.src: It's a good thing you have the best sharpshooter in all of Fruma on your side! A shot like that is nothing to me.
The Price of Ingenuity#269.dst: ¡Menos mal que tienes de tu lado a la mejor tiradora de toda Fruma! Un tiro así no es nada para mí.
The Price of Ingenuity#269.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#270.src: Just a moment... need to line it up... just right...
The Price of Ingenuity#270.dst: Un momento... tengo que alinearlo... justo así...
The Price of Ingenuity#270.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#271.src: Got it! Oh, that's more precarious than I expected. Be careful!
The Price of Ingenuity#271.dst: ¡Dado! Oh, esto es más precario de lo que esperaba. ¡Ten cuidado!
The Price of Ingenuity#271.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#273.src: ...okay, why are we right outside the Sovereign's mansion?!
The Price of Ingenuity#273.dst: ...vale, ¡¿por qué estamos justo delante de la mansión de la Soberana?!
The Price of Ingenuity#273.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#274.src: This place is so heavily guarded, and he just has a secret tunnel directly to the front door?!
The Price of Ingenuity#274.dst: ¡¿Este sitio está tan vigilado y él tiene un túnel secreto directo a la puerta principal?!
The Price of Ingenuity#274.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#276.src: We can't just leave it here, obviously, but we're definitely not getting through the front door...
The Price of Ingenuity#276.dst: Está claro que no podemos dejarlo estar, pero desde luego no vamos a entrar por la puerta principal...
The Price of Ingenuity#276.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#277.src: Look, up there. The arch connects to the main structure, and probably has a way inside.
The Price of Ingenuity#277.dst: Mira, ahí arriba. El arco conecta con el edificio principal, y seguro que hay forma de entrar.
The Price of Ingenuity#277.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#278.src: Maybe we can get up by climbing up this building over here!
The Price of Ingenuity#278.dst: ¡Quizá podamos subir trepando por este edificio de aquí!
The Price of Ingenuity#278.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#279.src: Travel up the nearby building at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and enter Soosu's mansion.
The Price of Ingenuity#279.dst: Sube por el edificio cercano en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] y entra en la mansión de Soosu.

The Price of Ingenuity#280.src: Sneak through Soosu's mansion looking for Yusanu at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#280.dst: Cuélate por la mansión de Soosu buscando a Yusanu en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#281.src: ... Hey, stay on your guard. We don't want to get caught in here.
The Price of Ingenuity#281.dst: ... Eh, mantente alerta. No queremos que nos pillen aquí.
The Price of Ingenuity#281.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#282.src: Though... it's kind of quiet in here. Weird.
The Price of Ingenuity#282.dst: Aunque... esto está bastante silencioso. Raro.
The Price of Ingenuity#282.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#283.src: Okay. Okay okay. That's a lot of buttons.
The Price of Ingenuity#283.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#284.src: So these two say up and down... over here it looks like a list...? Office, Workshop, Quarters, Workshop {~}, Roof Workshop... And why is there a lever? It's not even labeled.
The Price of Ingenuity#284.dst: Estos dos dicen arriba y abajo... y aquí... ¿parece una lista? Oficina, Taller, Dependencias, Taller {~}, Taller del tejado... ¿Y por qué hay una palanca? Ni está etiquetada.
The Price of Ingenuity#284.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#285.src: Ugh, I can never figure out Roughworks machines. Always overly complicated...
The Price of Ingenuity#285.dst: Uf, las máquinas de Roughworks nunca hay quien las entienda. Complicadas de más...
The Price of Ingenuity#285.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#286.src: Well, what about you? Any thoughts?
The Price of Ingenuity#286.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#287.src: Okay. Sure! As good a suggestion as any.
The Price of Ingenuity#287.dst: Vale. ¡Claro! Tan buena idea como otra.
The Price of Ingenuity#287.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#288.src: ...so, which one of these is up?
The Price of Ingenuity#288.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#290.src: Okay. Thanks for the input. I'm... not going to do that! That sounds like an awful idea- has Zeph been rubbing off on you?
The Price of Ingenuity#290.dst: Vale. Gracias por la aportación. ¡Yo... no pienso hacer eso! Suena a idea terrible- ¿se te está pegando lo de Zeph?
The Price of Ingenuity#290.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#291.src: And I thought one of him was bad enough...
The Price of Ingenuity#291.dst: Y yo que pensaba que con uno de él ya bastaba...
The Price of Ingenuity#291.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#292.src: Oh, whatever! Let's just try something.
The Price of Ingenuity#292.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#295.src: That was... I don't want to talk about it.
The Price of Ingenuity#295.dst: Eso ha sido... No quiero hablar de ello.
The Price of Ingenuity#295.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#296.src: Wait! {u}, quietly, come look at this.
The Price of Ingenuity#296.dst: ¡Espera! {u}, sin ruido, ven a ver esto.
The Price of Ingenuity#296.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#297.src: Shoot, they're coming this way! Follow me!
The Price of Ingenuity#297.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#299.src: Approximately {~} of the input fuel energy is lost as heat. This results in a poor overall performance.
The Price of Ingenuity#299.dst: Aproximadamente {~} de la energía del combustible se pierde en forma de calor. Esto da un rendimiento general pobre.

The Price of Ingenuity#304.src: N-O-O-O!!! Mother w-o-o-o-ould know what to do!
The Price of Ingenuity#304.speaker: Glitter

The Price of Ingenuity#306.src: Those "guards" don't seem very normal, do they? Isn't this supposed to be the Sovereign's mansion?
The Price of Ingenuity#306.dst: Esos "guardias" no parecen muy normales, ¿verdad? ¿Esto no era la mansión de la Soberana?
The Price of Ingenuity#306.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#307.src: They didn't even see us... oh, whatever. Let's keep moving.
The Price of Ingenuity#307.dst: Ni siquiera nos han visto... bah, da igual. Sigamos.
The Price of Ingenuity#307.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#309.src: Why did you call me here again so soon? I was just here yesterday.
The Price of Ingenuity#309.dst: ¿Por qué me has llamado otra vez tan pronto? Si estuve ayer.
The Price of Ingenuity#309.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#310.src: Oh, don't play dumb! Dead soldiers! Killed on the job! Sound familiar??
The Price of Ingenuity#310.dst: ¡Oh, no disimules! ¡Soldados muertos! ¡Caídos de servicio! ¿Te suena??
The Price of Ingenuity#310.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#312.src: Well, it better! Again - dead soldiers!! We had an agreement, Yus, and you've clearly gone and broken it!
The Price of Ingenuity#312.dst: ¡Más te vale! Repito- ¡¡soldados muertos!! Teníamos un trato, Yus, ¡y está claro que lo has roto!
The Price of Ingenuity#312.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#313.src: I- I know. And I'm sorry that it happened. But- it happened while I was here, working! What do you expect me to have done about it?!
The Price of Ingenuity#313.dst: L- lo sé. Y siento que pasara. Pero- ¡pasó mientras yo estaba aquí, trabajando! ¡¿Qué esperabas que hiciera?!
The Price of Ingenuity#313.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#314.src: Hmph! You're smart, aren't you? Smart enough to be able to grasp the fundamentals of conductivity and electrical currents! You could have found a way.
The Price of Ingenuity#314.dst: ¡Hmpf! Eres listo, ¿no? ¡Lo bastante listo para entender los fundamentos de la conductividad y las corrientes eléctricas! Podrías haber encontrado la manera.
The Price of Ingenuity#314.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#315.src: It's such a shame... you were one of my favorites, Yus. And now you've really let me down.
The Price of Ingenuity#315.dst: Qué lástima... eras uno de mis favoritos, Yus. Y ahora me has decepcionado de verdad.
The Price of Ingenuity#315.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#316.src: ...I know. I- I'll find a way to fix it. Tell me what to do, and- and I can. Whatever I need to- so I can keep them safe- I'll, I'll do it.
The Price of Ingenuity#316.dst: ...lo sé. Y- ya encontraré la forma de arreglarlo. Dime qué hacer y- y puedo. Lo que haga falta- con tal de mantenerlos a salvo- lo, lo haré.
The Price of Ingenuity#316.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#317.src: Oh, Yus, you're so silly. There's nothing you can do to fix this now. The damage is done, and nobody around here will shut! Up! About it!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#317.dst: Ay, Yus, qué tonto eres. Ya no hay nada que puedas hacer para arreglarlo. El daño está hecho, ¡y por aquí nadie va a cerrar! ¡La! ¡Boca!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#317.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#318.src: I let you live in that abandoned trainyard because I thought you'd be quiet. But this isn't quiet! I can't focus now that everyone is-
The Price of Ingenuity#318.dst: Te dejé vivir en esa estación abandonada porque pensé que estarías callado. ¡Pero esto no es estar callado! No me puedo concentrar ahora que todos-
The Price of Ingenuity#318.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#320.src: A GHO-O-O-OST! SPARKLES HEARD A GHO-O-O-O-OST! WHAT DO WE-E-E-E DO???
The Price of Ingenuity#320.dst: ¡UN FANTA-A-A-ASMA! ¡SPARKLES HA OÍDO UN FANTA-A-A-A-ASMA! ¿QUÉ HACE-E-E-EMOS???
The Price of Ingenuity#320.speaker: Glitter

The Price of Ingenuity#321.src: Ugh! Not now!! Can't you see mommy's busy?!
The Price of Ingenuity#321.dst: ¡Uf! ¡¡Ahora no!! ¡¿No veis que mamá está ocupada?!
The Price of Ingenuity#321.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#323.src: ...They'll be fine. I'll just bring them back later!
The Price of Ingenuity#323.dst: ...No les pasará nada. ¡Ya los traeré de vuelta luego!
The Price of Ingenuity#323.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#324.src: You know, they've been getting better and better at replicating human behavior! My latest constructs were at an estimated {~} accuracy-
The Price of Ingenuity#324.dst: ¿Sabes? ¡Cada vez replican mejor el comportamiento humano! Mis últimos constructos alcanzaban un {~} de precisión estimado-
The Price of Ingenuity#324.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#326.src: Right! Here's what you can do for me, Yus. This isn't going to go away. I need someone to pin this on, so they'll all shut up and move on from it!
The Price of Ingenuity#326.dst: ¡Eso! Esto es lo que puedes hacer por mí, Yus. Esto no se va a esfumar. Necesito a alguien a quien culpar, ¡para que todos se callen y pasen página!
The Price of Ingenuity#326.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#327.src: Especially that loudmouth from the north! Would it kill him to leave me alone and stop meddling in my business??
The Price of Ingenuity#327.dst: ¡Sobre todo ese bocazas del norte! ¿Le costaría mucho dejarme en paz y no meterse en mis asuntos??
The Price of Ingenuity#327.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#328.src: Don't answer that. Look, this is the only way. You need to hand over whoever is responsible for this whole thing. That's the only way we can keep our peace and keep being friends.
The Price of Ingenuity#328.dst: No contestes. Mira, es la única forma. Tienes que entregar a quien sea responsable de todo esto. Es la única manera de mantener la paz y de seguir siendo amigos.
The Price of Ingenuity#328.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#329.src: Wh- you can't be serious! I can't do that, Soosu! You- you really expect me to give up one of my friends or family?!
The Price of Ingenuity#329.dst: Qu- ¡no hablarás en serio! ¡No puedo, Soosu! ¡¿De verdad esperas que entregue a un amigo o a mi familia?!
The Price of Ingenuity#329.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#330.src: No, Yus, what I expected from you was to keep your "friends and family" quiet! But we're past that point now. Something needs to happen.
The Price of Ingenuity#330.dst: No, Yus, lo que esperaba de ti era que mantuvieras callados a tus "amigos y familia". Pero ya hemos pasado ese punto. Algo tiene que ocurrir.
The Price of Ingenuity#330.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#331.src: I-... I understand. I need to think. I'll... I'll let you know soon.
The Price of Ingenuity#331.dst: Yo-... lo entiendo. Necesito pensar. Ya... ya te diré algo pronto.
The Price of Ingenuity#331.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#332.src: What is he doing?! Sneaking around, meeting with the Sovereign?!
The Price of Ingenuity#332.dst: ¡¿Qué hace?! ¡¿Escabullirse para reunirse con la Soberana?!
The Price of Ingenuity#332.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#333.src: We need to cut him off. I'm not letting him get away with this. Follow me, quickly!
The Price of Ingenuity#333.dst: Tenemos que cortarle el paso. No pienso dejar que se salga con la suya. ¡Sígueme, rápido!
The Price of Ingenuity#333.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#334.src: Come on! Let's see if we can cut him off before he enters the tunnel!
The Price of Ingenuity#334.dst: ¡Vamos! ¡A ver si le cortamos el paso antes de que entre en el túnel!
The Price of Ingenuity#334.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#335.dst: Espera a que Yusanu vuelva en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#336.src: Okay. This is as good a place as any to hide out and wait...
The Price of Ingenuity#336.dst: Vale. Este sitio es tan bueno como otro para escondernos y esperar...
The Price of Ingenuity#336.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#337.src: I can't believe this! I can't believe him! How long has he been doing this?
The Price of Ingenuity#337.dst: ¡No me lo puedo creer! ¡No me lo creo de él! ¿Cuánto lleva haciendo esto?
The Price of Ingenuity#337.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#338.src: I... uh, I'll see you guys later, I... guess.
The Price of Ingenuity#338.dst: Yo... eh, nos vemos luego, chicos... supongo.
The Price of Ingenuity#338.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#342.src: Not a word, Yusanu. You are in no position to be asking questions!
The Price of Ingenuity#342.dst: Ni una palabra, Yusanu. ¡No estás en posición de hacer preguntas!
The Price of Ingenuity#342.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#343.src: Secretly meeting with the Sovereign? Really? Are you insane?!
The Price of Ingenuity#343.dst: ¿Reuniones secretas con la Soberana? ¿En serio? ¡¿Estás loco?!
The Price of Ingenuity#343.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#344.src: You- you... followed me... oh, no... no no no, no... you weren't seen, were you? You're going to ruin ev-
The Price of Ingenuity#344.dst: Me- me... habéis seguido... oh, no... no no no, no... no os han visto, ¿verdad? Lo vais a arruinar to-
The Price of Ingenuity#344.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#345.src: We're going to ruin everything?! And not you, the guy always sneaking off to meet the Sovereign?!
The Price of Ingenuity#345.dst: ¡¿QUE NOSOTROS lo vamos a arruinar todo?! ¡¿Y no tú, el que siempre se escapa a ver a la Soberana?!
The Price of Ingenuity#345.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#346.src: You don't understand! The only reason we're safe down there is BECAUSE I struck a deal with her!!
The Price of Ingenuity#346.dst: ¡No lo entendéis! ¡¡Ahí abajo estamos a salvo PORQUE hice un trato con ella!!
The Price of Ingenuity#346.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#348.src: I work as her assistant in her workshop, help her with whatever projects she's working on, and in exchange she allows us to live in the station!
The Price of Ingenuity#348.dst: ¡Trabajo como su ayudante en su taller, la ayudo con los proyectos que tenga entre manos, y a cambio nos deja vivir en la estación!
The Price of Ingenuity#348.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#349.src: As long as we don't cause any trouble with soldiers, at least- which, might I remind you, you people caused? So don't- don't act like...
The Price of Ingenuity#349.dst: Mientras no causemos problemas con los soldados, al menos- cosa que, os recuerdo, causasteis vosotros. Así que no- no os hagáis los...
The Price of Ingenuity#349.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#350.src: Oh my god, you idiot. How long were you planning to keep this a secret? Were you ever going to tell anyone?
The Price of Ingenuity#350.dst: Dios mío, idiota. ¿Cuánto pensabas guardar este secreto? ¿Ibas a contárselo a alguien alguna vez?
The Price of Ingenuity#350.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#351.src: You were just gonna let it sit until, inevitably , someone was going to piss off the soldiers? Because, trust me, that would have happened eventually. With or without us.
The Price of Ingenuity#351.dst: ¿Ibas a dejarlo estar hasta que, inevitablemente, alguien cabreara a los soldados? Porque, créeme, habría pasado tarde o temprano. Con nosotros o sin nosotros.
The Price of Ingenuity#351.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#352.src: Status: On Hold. She needs my attention elsewhere.
The Price of Ingenuity#352.dst: Estado: En pausa. Me necesita en otra cosa.

The Price of Ingenuity#354.src: Ack! You- you heard that part too?
The Price of Ingenuity#354.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#356.src: Ughhh.... I don't know! I don't know. I don't want to, obviously! You're all good people, and it'd break every single one of our guidelines to throw someone out like that!
The Price of Ingenuity#356.dst: Uffff.... ¡No lo sé! No lo sé. ¡Claro que no quiero! Sois todos buena gente, ¡y entregar a alguien así rompería todas y cada una de nuestras normas!
The Price of Ingenuity#356.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#357.src: But... I don't think I have a choice. The Steel Feather's safety is on the line, and I could fix it by just- just- handing someone over, but- I- I can't. I can't do that.
The Price of Ingenuity#357.dst: Pero... no creo que tenga elección. La seguridad de la Pluma de Acero está en juego, y podría arreglarlo simplemente- simplemente- entregando a alguien, pero- no- no puedo. No puedo hacer eso.
The Price of Ingenuity#357.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#358.src: Okay. You were doing what you thought was right. I can understand that. But this - keeping secrets, following their rules - it was never going to end well!
The Price of Ingenuity#358.dst: Vale. Hacías lo que creías correcto. Eso lo entiendo. Pero esto - guardar secretos, seguir sus reglas - ¡nunca iba a acabar bien!
The Price of Ingenuity#358.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#359.src: We can get past this choice by doing what we were already doing - trying to take down the crown! If we succeed, there won't be any more risk for you all.
The Price of Ingenuity#359.dst: Podemos superar esa decisión haciendo lo que ya hacíamos - ¡derribar a la Corona! Si lo logramos, ya no correréis ningún riesgo.
The Price of Ingenuity#359.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#361.src: This is your chance to make it right, Yusanu! You have information. Tell us what you and the Sovereign were working on. Is it important?
The Price of Ingenuity#361.dst: ¡Esta es tu oportunidad de arreglarlo, Yusanu! Tienes información. Cuéntanos en qué trabajabais la Soberana y tú. ¿Es importante?
The Price of Ingenuity#361.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#362.src: ...I don't know much about... what it is. I know it's not a weapon, at least- Soosu was clear on that. It's... an important assignment from the Queen.
The Price of Ingenuity#362.dst: ...no sé mucho sobre... lo que es. Sé que no es un arma, al menos- Soosu fue clara en eso. Es... un encargo importante de la Reina.
The Price of Ingenuity#362.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#363.src: It's- it's strange. Very, very strange. It uses science that sounds... impossible. I think we're building over an existing device, something the Queen already had.
The Price of Ingenuity#363.dst: Es- es extraño. Muy, muy extraño. Usa una ciencia que suena... imposible. Creo que construimos sobre un aparato ya existente, algo que la Reina ya tenía.
The Price of Ingenuity#363.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#364.src: Soosu... she's stressed about the project. She needs to get it done, but it- it seems like an impossible task. There's something on the line for her.
The Price of Ingenuity#364.dst: Soosu... está agobiada con el proyecto. Necesita terminarlo, pero- parece una tarea imposible. Hay algo en juego para ella.
The Price of Ingenuity#364.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#365.src: ...mysterious device, important to the crown... got it. {u}, Yusanu- we need to steal it. If it's important to the crown... whatever it does, it's better if they don't have it.
The Price of Ingenuity#365.dst: ...aparato misterioso, importante para la Corona... entendido. {u}, Yusanu- tenemos que robarlo. Si es importante para la Corona... haga lo que haga, mejor que no lo tengan.
The Price of Ingenuity#365.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#366.src: Wh- what?! You can't be serious! We can't just-
The Price of Ingenuity#366.dst: ¡¿Q- qué?! ¡No puedes hablar en serio! No podemos sin más-
The Price of Ingenuity#366.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#367.src: We can, and we should! The Sovereigns aren't your friends, Yusanu, they're complicit in and responsible for everything wrong with Fruma!!
The Price of Ingenuity#367.dst: ¡Podemos, y debemos! Los Soberanos no son tus amigos, Yusanu, ¡¡son cómplices y responsables de todo lo que va mal en Fruma!!
The Price of Ingenuity#367.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#368.src: If we can hurt them, then we can hurt the crown. And if we can hurt the crown... we might actually stand a chance.
The Price of Ingenuity#368.dst: Si les hacemos daño, dañamos a la Corona. Y si dañamos a la Corona... puede que tengamos una oportunidad real.
The Price of Ingenuity#368.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#369.src: ...okay. Okay, fine! You're right. You're... right.
The Price of Ingenuity#369.dst: ...vale. ¡Vale, está bien! Tienes razón. Tienes... razón.
The Price of Ingenuity#369.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#370.src: I can get you to it. Uh... how did you get in, anyway?
The Price of Ingenuity#370.dst: Puedo llevaros hasta él. Eh... por cierto, ¿cómo habéis entrado?
The Price of Ingenuity#370.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#371.src: We'll show you. Come on, back in we go.
The Price of Ingenuity#371.dst: Te lo enseñamos. Venga, para dentro.
The Price of Ingenuity#371.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#372.dst: Entra de nuevo en la mansión en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#374.dst: Sigue a Yusanu hasta el taller de Soosu.

The Price of Ingenuity#375.src: Right, we'll need to be fast. Soosu tends to spend most of her time in the workshops...
The Price of Ingenuity#375.dst: Bien, tendremos que ser rápidos. Soosu suele pasar casi todo el tiempo en los talleres...
The Price of Ingenuity#375.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#377.src: I... would probably be fine. But if she sees you two, then...
The Price of Ingenuity#377.dst: A mí... seguramente no me pasaría nada. Pero si os ve a vosotros dos, entonces...
The Price of Ingenuity#377.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#378.src: So don't get caught, got it. I'm guessing we wouldn't stand a chance fighting her?
The Price of Ingenuity#378.dst: Así que no nos pillen, vale. ¿Contra ella no tendríamos nada que hacer?
The Price of Ingenuity#378.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#379.src: No!! No, no, absolutely not. Her blessing... I haven't seen her use it in combat, but knowing what it can do...
The Price of Ingenuity#379.dst: ¡¡No!! No, no, en absoluto. Su bendición... no se la he visto usar en combate, pero sabiendo lo que puede hacer...
The Price of Ingenuity#379.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#380.src: Being able to mold matter... it means more than just putting together machines. So...
The Price of Ingenuity#380.dst: Poder moldear la materia... eso es mucho más que montar máquinas. Así que...
The Price of Ingenuity#380.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#381.src: It won't come to that. Come on, let's get going.
The Price of Ingenuity#381.dst: No llegaremos a eso. Venga, en marcha.
The Price of Ingenuity#381.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#382.src: The door to the workshop has already been unlocked...
The Price of Ingenuity#382.dst: La puerta del taller ya está abierta...

The Price of Ingenuity#384.dst: [+{~} vales de la Pluma de Acero]

The Price of Ingenuity#385.dst: Módulo de Desplazamiento Cuántico - Notas de investigación

The Price of Ingenuity#386.src: Alright, before we descend - Soosu has a bunch of golems walking around her workshop.
The Price of Ingenuity#386.dst: Bien, antes de bajar - Soosu tiene un montón de gólems paseando por su taller.
The Price of Ingenuity#386.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#387.src: They're more... uh, advanced than Sparkles and Glitter. If they see us, they'll sound the alarms. So don't get caught!
The Price of Ingenuity#387.dst: Son más... eh, avanzados que Sparkles y Glitter. Si nos ven, darán la alarma. ¡Así que no os pillen!
The Price of Ingenuity#387.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#388.src: How did you two even manage to find me?
The Price of Ingenuity#388.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#389.src: Really? I'm... surprised the system held together long enough for that.
The Price of Ingenuity#389.dst: ¿En serio? Me... sorprende que el sistema aguantara tanto.
The Price of Ingenuity#389.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#390.src: Look, it's not our fault this... thing doesn't come with an instruction manual!
The Price of Ingenuity#390.dst: ¡Oye, no es culpa nuestra que esta... cosa no traiga manual!
The Price of Ingenuity#390.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#391.src: Ha! Okay, it's a little hard to figure out. You have to pick the destination, then hit up or down, and then pull the lever to turn it on! Simple.
The Price of Ingenuity#391.dst: ¡Ja! Vale, cuesta un poco entenderlo. ¡Eliges el destino, luego pulsas arriba o abajo y después tiras de la palanca para encenderlo! Sencillo.
The Price of Ingenuity#391.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#392.src: That... sounds right, but the way you say that is concerning. What actually happened?
The Price of Ingenuity#392.dst: Eso... suena bien, pero cómo lo dices me preocupa. ¿Qué pasó en realidad?
The Price of Ingenuity#392.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#393.src: Ugh, it doesn't matter what happened. What matters is this stupid box is overly complicated and annoying!
The Price of Ingenuity#393.dst: Uf, da igual lo que pasara. ¡Lo que importa es que esta caja estúpida es complicada de más y un fastidio!
The Price of Ingenuity#393.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#394.src: Okay, okay! It is... a little hard to figure out. You have to pick the destination, then hit up or down, and then pull the lever to turn it on! Simple.
The Price of Ingenuity#394.dst: ¡Vale, vale! Cuesta... un poco entenderlo. ¡Eliges el destino, luego pulsas arriba o abajo y después tiras de la palanca para encenderlo! Sencillo.
The Price of Ingenuity#394.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#395.src: ...I chose the music, by the way.
The Price of Ingenuity#395.dst: ...la música la elegí yo, por cierto.
The Price of Ingenuity#395.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#397.src: Oh... I forgot how much of a mess it was down here.
The Price of Ingenuity#397.dst: Oh... se me había olvidado el desastre que hay aquí abajo.
The Price of Ingenuity#397.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#398.src: Sneak through the mansion avoiding the guards.
The Price of Ingenuity#398.dst: Cuélate por la mansión evitando a los guardias.

The Price of Ingenuity#399.src: Alright! That's our goal, over there.
The Price of Ingenuity#399.speaker: Yusanu
