The Price of Ingenuity#400.src: It's the most important sector of Soosu's workshop.
The Price of Ingenuity#400.dst: Es el sector más importante del taller de Soosu.
The Price of Ingenuity#400.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#401.src: Look around Soosu's workshop for the device.
The Price of Ingenuity#401.dst: Busca el aparato por el taller de Soosu.

The Price of Ingenuity#402.src: And you're sure she won't be coming down here?
The Price of Ingenuity#402.dst: ¿Y seguro que no va a bajar aquí?
The Price of Ingenuity#402.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#403.src: Uh... mostly. {~} sure. We should be fine today, if we move quickly.
The Price of Ingenuity#403.dst: Eh... más o menos. Seguro al {~}. Hoy no debería pasar nada si nos damos prisa.
The Price of Ingenuity#403.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#405.src: The festival's coming up, so she has a lot to handle. She'll be busy cleaning up the other workshops, building whatever contraptions she needs for this year's festival... that sort of stuff.
The Price of Ingenuity#405.dst: Se acerca el festival, tiene mucho entre manos. Estará limpiando los otros talleres, construyendo los artilugios que necesite para el festival de este año... ese tipo de cosas.
The Price of Ingenuity#405.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#406.src: She only comes down here for the big projects. Well, or when she needs to let out some steam. But she doesn't have anything going on today, so... we're safe.
The Price of Ingenuity#406.dst: Aquí abajo solo baja para los proyectos grandes. Bueno, o cuando necesita desahogarse. Pero hoy no tiene nada entre manos, así que... estamos a salvo.
The Price of Ingenuity#406.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#407.src: ...if you say so, Yusanu. Still, I'd rather be out of here quickly.
The Price of Ingenuity#407.dst: ...si tú lo dices, Yusanu. Aun así, prefiero salir de aquí cuanto antes.
The Price of Ingenuity#407.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#408.src: Yeah... same. Let's take the device and go.
The Price of Ingenuity#408.dst: Sí... yo también. Cojamos el aparato y vámonos.
The Price of Ingenuity#408.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#409.src: This is Soosu's favorite room in the workshop. Her golem creation room.
The Price of Ingenuity#409.dst: Esta es la sala favorita de Soosu en el taller. Su sala de creación de gólems.
The Price of Ingenuity#409.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#410.src: She... told me once that she likes working with plants. It's why a lot of her golems are built off of flower pots and soil.
The Price of Ingenuity#410.dst: Ella... me dijo una vez que le gusta trabajar con plantas. Por eso muchos de sus gólems están hechos a partir de macetas y tierra.
The Price of Ingenuity#410.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#411.src: Hm. Well, good thing she's using her blessing on this, and not... I don't know. Reshaping the whole world?
The Price of Ingenuity#411.dst: Hm. Bueno, menos mal que usa su bendición en esto y no en... no sé. ¿Remodelar el mundo entero?
The Price of Ingenuity#411.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#412.src: A-another golem? Should we turn back?
The Price of Ingenuity#412.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#413.src: Oh, hey, it's Flowers! That's Soosu's favourite golem! Wonder why he's sleeping here and not on his Flowersbed, though. ... I wasn't the one that named that.
The Price of Ingenuity#413.dst: ¡Oh, eh, si es Flowers! ¡Es el gólem favorito de Soosu! Aunque no sé por qué duerme aquí y no en su Flowerscama. ... Ese nombre no lo puse yo.
The Price of Ingenuity#413.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#414.src: Finally!!! He said yes!!! Uncle T finally let me visit his workshop, I'm so excited!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#414.dst: ¡¡¡Por fin!!! ¡¡¡Ha dicho que sí!!! ¡El tío T por fin me deja visitar su taller, qué ilusión!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#414.speaker: 125 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#415.src: He's real!! Flowers is REAL NOW!!!! I showed Ma my drawing, and she helped me sew him together!! Now I can match with Fiona! She has Daruma, and I have... Flowers!
The Price of Ingenuity#415.dst: ¡¡Es de verdad!! ¡¡¡¡Flowers ya es DE VERDAD!!!! ¡¡Le enseñé mi dibujo a mamá y me ayudó a coserlo!! ¡Ahora hago juego con Fiona! Ella tiene a Daruma y yo tengo a... ¡Flowers!
The Price of Ingenuity#415.speaker: 125 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#416.src: Hmph. Hmph!!!!!!! Fiona's old enough now, she's gotta work too... she's always so tired now, she won't play with me anymore!!!! This sucks. This sucks!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#416.dst: Hmpf. ¡Hmpf!!!!!!! Fiona ya tiene edad y también trabaja... ¡¡¡¡siempre está cansada y ya no juega conmigo!!!! Es un asco. ¡¡¡¡Un asco!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#416.speaker: 126 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#417.src: Uncle T agreed to help me make the super ultra cow milker o-matic!!
The Price of Ingenuity#417.dst: ¡¡El tío T va a ayudarme a hacer la súper ordeñadora automática!!
The Price of Ingenuity#417.speaker: 126 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#419.src: Grrrrrr............ I haven't written in AGES......... and it's because I gotta WORK!!!! In the FIELDS!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#419.dst: Grrrrrr............ ¡¡¡¡Llevo SIGLOS sin escribir......... y es porque tengo que TRABAJAR!!!! ¡¡¡¡En los CAMPOS!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#419.speaker: 127 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#420.src: I've been READING!! Reading so so many books... about FARMING!
The Price of Ingenuity#420.dst: ¡¡He estado LEYENDO!! Leyendo muchísimos libros... ¡sobre AGRICULTURA!
The Price of Ingenuity#420.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#421.src: It's that time of year again!! The FESTIVAL OF THE CROWN!!! Just a week away!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#421.dst: ¡¡Otra vez esa época del año!! ¡¡¡EL FESTIVAL DE LA CORONA!!! ¡¡¡Solo falta una semana!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#421.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#422.src: Weird thing happened today. Uncle T came home with a strange man from the military, big ol fancy uniform and all!
The Price of Ingenuity#422.dst: Hoy pasó algo raro. ¡El tío T vino a casa con un hombre extraño del ejército, con un uniforme elegantísimo y todo!
The Price of Ingenuity#422.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#423.src: It turns out, the Crown really liked my super duper farmer!! Cause it makes it easier to harvest crops and stuff, they want us to make more of them, so everyone can do their work faster!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#423.dst: ¡¡Resulta que a la Corona le gustó mucho mi súper mega granjero!! Como facilita cosechar y esas cosas, quieren que hagamos más, ¡¡¡para que todos trabajen más rápido!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#423.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#424.src: Ugh...... ughhhhhhhh......... UGHHHHHHH...... I'm so TIRED!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#424.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#425.src: Uncle T got really hurt today. Really, really, really hurt.
The Price of Ingenuity#425.dst: Hoy el tío T se hizo mucho daño. Muchísimo, muchísimo daño.
The Price of Ingenuity#425.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#426.src: Ma says Uncle T's gonna be okay. He will.
The Price of Ingenuity#426.dst: Mamá dice que el tío T se pondrá bien. Se pondrá.
The Price of Ingenuity#426.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#429.src: The Citadel was AWESOME!!! I've always dreamed of going up there, someday... and now I HAVE!!
The Price of Ingenuity#429.dst: ¡¡¡La Ciudadela fue INCREÍBLE!!! Siempre soñé con subir allí algún día... ¡¡y ya lo HE HECHO!!
The Price of Ingenuity#429.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#430.src: Work on project E-lec-tricity is ongoing (yes, the name changed... the Sovereign didn't like what I called it before...... bleh.), and it's going really well!!
The Price of Ingenuity#430.dst: El proyecto E-lec-tricidad sigue en marcha (sí, le cambiaron el nombre... al Soberano no le gustó el que le puse antes...... bah.), ¡¡y va genial!!
The Price of Ingenuity#430.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#431.src: OKAY!!! DO NOT PANIC!!!! BUT THINGS! ARE! HAPPENING!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#431.speaker: 130 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#433.src: Looking back at these entries, I... I feel hollow.
The Price of Ingenuity#433.dst: Al releer estas entradas, yo... me siento vacía.
The Price of Ingenuity#433.speaker: 3 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#434.src: Mother passed away from her illness, a few days ago. They knew it was coming for a while, apparently, but... it was still a shock.
The Price of Ingenuity#434.dst: Mamá murió de su enfermedad hace unos días. Parece que hacía tiempo que sabían que llegaría, pero... aun así fue un golpe.
The Price of Ingenuity#434.speaker: 4 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#435.src: What's the point in writing these, anymore? I don't know what to say. I could talk about my projects, about all the progress I've been making, but it all feels so hollow.
The Price of Ingenuity#435.dst: ¿Qué sentido tiene seguir escribiendo esto? No sé qué decir. Podría hablar de mis proyectos, de todos los avances que he hecho, pero todo se siente tan vacío.
The Price of Ingenuity#435.speaker: 10 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#436.src: How many years has it been? I can check the dates, but... I don't want to.
The Price of Ingenuity#436.dst: ¿Cuántos años han pasado? Puedo mirar las fechas, pero... no quiero.
The Price of Ingenuity#436.speaker: 40 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#437.src: Never forget, never stop creating, never give in!
The Price of Ingenuity#437.dst: ¡No olvides nunca, no dejes nunca de crear, no cedas jamás!
The Price of Ingenuity#437.speaker: 45 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#438.src: And there it is... looking at it like this, it really is impressive.
The Price of Ingenuity#438.dst: Y ahí está... visto así, es realmente impresionante.
The Price of Ingenuity#438.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#439.src: Again, you really don't know what this is for? And more importantly, which of us will carry it out?
The Price of Ingenuity#439.dst: Otra vez: ¿de verdad no sabes para qué sirve esto? Y más importante, ¿quién de nosotros lo llevará?
The Price of Ingenuity#439.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#440.src: I'd say until we're in the clear, {u} should carry it. And no... I really, absolutely do not. Every time I've asked Soosu to elaborate, she's just blown me off.
The Price of Ingenuity#440.dst: Yo diría que hasta que estemos a salvo lo lleve {u}. Y no... de verdad, no tengo ni idea. Cada vez que le he pedido a Soosu que me lo explique, me ha dado largas.
The Price of Ingenuity#440.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#441.src: Well. Whatever this is, it can't be any good if the Crown wants it. {u}, are you ready?
The Price of Ingenuity#441.dst: Bueno. Sea lo que sea, no puede ser bueno si la Corona lo quiere. {u}, ¿vamos?
The Price of Ingenuity#441.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#442.src: Wait. Do you also hear that sound? Are those footsteps?
The Price of Ingenuity#442.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#443.src: Can't be anything else - and there's two pairs of them. So Soosu is here, but with whom...?
The Price of Ingenuity#443.dst: No puede ser otra cosa - y son dos pares. Así que Soosu está aquí, pero ¿con quién...?
The Price of Ingenuity#443.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#444.src: ...are you sure this is the best idea? Dividing your attention between the discussion, and your...projects... It hasn't worked out in the past.
The Price of Ingenuity#444.dst: ...¿seguro que es buena idea? Dividir tu atención entre la conversación y tus...proyectos... En el pasado no ha salido bien.
The Price of Ingenuity#444.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#445.src: Well, you know, Zhiraok, not eeeveryone seems to have the time to drop everything and leave their region. Sometimes, we have a job to do.
The Price of Ingenuity#445.dst: Pues, ya sabes, Zhiraok, no to-o-odo el mundo tiene tiempo de dejarlo todo y salir de su región. A veces tenemos un trabajo que hacer.
The Price of Ingenuity#445.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#446.src: Ah, there you are, Flowers! Wakey wakey, sleepyhead - you've got some guarding to get back to!
The Price of Ingenuity#446.dst: ¡Ah, ahí estás, Flowers! Despierta, dormilón - ¡tienes que volver a hacer guardia!
The Price of Ingenuity#446.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#448.src: Awareness, Soosu! A bit of warning before you stop like that?
The Price of Ingenuity#448.dst: ¡Atención, Soosu! ¿Podrías avisar antes de pararte así?
The Price of Ingenuity#448.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#449.src: Hm? Ah, sorry, sorry, but an unexpected run-in with a close friend is just sooo nice! Surely there's space somewhere in your mind to know that, hmm?
The Price of Ingenuity#449.dst: ¿Hm? Ah, perdona, perdona, ¡pero toparse por sorpresa con un amigo íntimo es taaan agradable! Seguro que en tu cabeza hay hueco para eso, ¿hmm?
The Price of Ingenuity#449.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#450.src: Soosu... This is a solved problem! How many times have I told you that? ...Alright, look, that's a tangent. What I really need to tell you-
The Price of Ingenuity#450.dst: Soosu... ¡Ese problema ya está resuelto! ¿Cuántas veces te lo he dicho? ...Está bien, mira, eso es una tangente. Lo que de verdad tengo que decirte-
The Price of Ingenuity#450.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#451.src: Escape the workshop without being spotted.
The Price of Ingenuity#451.dst: Escapa del taller sin que te vean.

The Price of Ingenuity#452.src: Soosu's here? And with Zhiraok, of all people?! We have to get out, now!
The Price of Ingenuity#452.dst: ¿Soosu está aquí? ¡¿Y con Zhiraok, nada menos?! ¡Tenemos que salir, ya!
The Price of Ingenuity#452.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#453.src: Yeah, but I bet Soosu's got Flowers on high alert! Don't use your magic, and whatever you do, don't get spotted!
The Price of Ingenuity#453.dst: ¡Sí, pero seguro que Flowers está en alerta máxima! ¡No uses tu magia y, pase lo que pase, que no te vean!
The Price of Ingenuity#453.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#454.src: Wait- What's that, Flowers? Intruders?! Right by the device room?!
The Price of Ingenuity#454.dst: Espera- ¿Qué, Flowers? ¡¿Intrusos?! ¡¿Al lado de la sala del aparato?!
The Price of Ingenuity#454.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#455.src: ...!! The Cursed!! You're not laying one digit on her, you hear me?!
The Price of Ingenuity#455.dst: ...!! ¡¡El Maldito!! ¡No le vas a poner un dedo encima, ¿me oyes?!
The Price of Ingenuity#455.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#456.src: Wh-what the helix- Infiltrators! You aren't getting away this time!
The Price of Ingenuity#456.dst: ¿Pe-pero qué hélice- ¡Infiltrados! ¡Esta vez no os escapáis!
The Price of Ingenuity#456.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#457.src: Yusanu?! Who is that with you? Wait, are you trying to steal the device?!
The Price of Ingenuity#457.dst: ¡¿Yusanu?! ¿Quién va contigo? Espera, ¡¿estáis intentando robar el aparato?!
The Price of Ingenuity#457.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#458.src: Hello, we're meant to run! Are you even taking this seriously?!
The Price of Ingenuity#458.dst: ¡Oye, que tenemos que correr! ¡¿Te lo estás tomando en serio siquiera?!
The Price of Ingenuity#458.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#459.src: ...you're smart enough that I shouldn't need to reiterate this! I know you are! Please, take the problem seriously!
The Price of Ingenuity#459.dst: ...¡eres lo bastante lista como para que no tenga que repetirlo! ¡Sé que lo eres! ¡Por favor, tómate el problema en serio!
The Price of Ingenuity#459.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#460.src: A set of criminals is in your quadrant, the Cursed behind the Torann massacre is with them, they're infil-
The Price of Ingenuity#460.dst: Hay criminales en tu cuadrante, con ellos va el Maldito de la masacre de Torann, están infiltr-
The Price of Ingenuity#460.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#461.src: Oh my god, Z, I get it!!! All you do is yap yap yap yap YAP!!! Give me some room to think!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#461.dst: ¡¡¡Dios mío, Z, ya lo he pillado!!! ¡¡¡No paras de ladrar, ladrar, ladrar, LADRAR!!! ¡¡¡Déjame espacio para pensar!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#461.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#462.src: Bla bla criminals, bla bla cursed one, et cetera et cetera et cetera!!!! Yes, I know how important it is! Flowers, hold this steady for me, won't you?
The Price of Ingenuity#462.dst: ¡¡¡¡Bla bla criminales, bla bla maldito, etcétera etcétera etcétera!!!! ¡Sí, ya sé lo importante que es! Flowers, sujétame esto firme, ¿quieres?
The Price of Ingenuity#462.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#463.src: As long as your focus is on the solutions, not your... But, Soosu, I haven't heard anything from you. There was key information I had to learn offhand!
The Price of Ingenuity#463.dst: Mientras te centres en las soluciones y no en tus... Pero, Soosu, de ti no he sabido nada. ¡Había datos clave que tuve que averiguar de pasada!
The Price of Ingenuity#463.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#464.src: One of your commanders summarized the topic for me. I should've heard it from you! So...what's your angle? It feels like you're ignoring the issue.
The Price of Ingenuity#464.dst: Uno de tus comandantes me resumió el tema. ¡Debería haberlo oído de ti! Así que...¿cuál es tu ángulo? Parece que ignoras el problema.
The Price of Ingenuity#464.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#465.src: ...Soosu? Soosu, are you listening? I asked you a question!
The Price of Ingenuity#465.dst: ...¿Soosu? Soosu, ¿me escuchas? ¡Te he hecho una pregunta!
The Price of Ingenuity#465.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#466.src: Hm? Yeah, yeah, sure. Hey, could you fetch me some bolts?
The Price of Ingenuity#466.dst: ¿Hm? Sí, sí, claro. Oye, ¿me traes unos pernos?
The Price of Ingenuity#466.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#467.src: ...fine, sure- But please, we have to round this out, Soosu. You have to get involved.
The Price of Ingenuity#467.dst: ...vale, de acuerdo- Pero por favor, tenemos que redondear esto, Soosu. Tienes que implicarte.
The Price of Ingenuity#467.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#468.src: Oh, right, about Flowers. Could you go check if his body picked up any parts while walking that I could use?
The Price of Ingenuity#468.dst: Ah, sí, sobre Flowers. ¿Puedes mirar si su cuerpo ha recogido al andar alguna pieza que me sirva?
The Price of Ingenuity#468.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#469.src: I knew letting you work in here was irrational. There's such a greater sum of problems than your toys! You're acting like a child, but you aren't one!
The Price of Ingenuity#469.dst: Sabía que dejarte trabajar aquí era irracional. ¡Hay una suma de problemas mucho mayor que tus juguetes! ¡Te comportas como una niña, y no lo eres!
The Price of Ingenuity#469.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#470.src: I know you can do such good work if you just apply yourself! Why are you just ignoring a high-ranking defector and a Cursed exponentiating each others' threat?!
The Price of Ingenuity#470.dst: ¡Sé el buen trabajo que puedes hacer si te aplicas! ¡¿Por qué ignoras a una desertora de alto rango y a un Maldito que elevan a potencia la amenaza del otro?!
The Price of Ingenuity#470.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#471.src: Do you think you're better than me, Zhiraok?
The Price of Ingenuity#471.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#472.src: Oh, look at Soosu, always so inattentive and clueless, always ignoring the needs of her district, always cooped up in her laboratory.
The Price of Ingenuity#472.dst: Ay, mirad a Soosu, siempre tan distraída y despistada, siempre ignorando las necesidades de su distrito, siempre encerrada en su laboratorio.
The Price of Ingenuity#472.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#473.src: Who even cares about the work she does? The projects she's assigned?! Who even cares that she knows, she knows, she KNOWS!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#473.dst: ¿A quién le importa el trabajo que hace? ¡¿Los proyectos que le asignan?! ¡¿A quién le importa que ella sepa, que sepa, que SEPA!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#473.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#474.src: ...Hm! Maybe you are better, Z. If you weren't, maybe we wouldn't be here right now!!
The Price of Ingenuity#474.dst: ...¡Hm! Puede que sí seas mejor, Z. ¡¡Si no lo fueras, quizá ahora no estaríamos aquí!!
The Price of Ingenuity#474.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#475.src: I... ... ...I'm sorry Soosu. That...that wasn't my angle, I didn't mean t-
The Price of Ingenuity#475.dst: Yo... ... ...lo siento, Soosu. Ese...ese no era mi ángulo, no pretendía-
The Price of Ingenuity#475.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#476.src: But you did! Hand me cog C-{~}, would you?
The Price of Ingenuity#476.dst: ¡Pero lo has hecho! Pásame el engranaje C-{~}, ¿quieres?
The Price of Ingenuity#476.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#477.src: ...alright. I just want to reach the end of this sequence as fast as possible.
The Price of Ingenuity#477.dst: ...está bien. Solo quiero llegar al final de esta secuencia lo antes posible.
The Price of Ingenuity#477.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#478.src: That makes two of us. I'm working on it. You can stop bugging me about it!!
The Price of Ingenuity#478.dst: Ya somos dos. Estoy en ello. ¡¡Puedes dejar de darme la lata!!
The Price of Ingenuity#478.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#479.src: ...maybe I should've been paying more attention. I didn't realize her project was putting so much weight on your shoulders. And I promised to help, too...
The Price of Ingenuity#479.dst: ...quizá debería haber prestado más atención. No me di cuenta de que su proyecto te cargaba tanto los hombros. Y encima prometí ayudar...
The Price of Ingenuity#479.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#480.src: Preliminary results suggest significantly improved utilization of energy, and reduced pollution. (Cleaner air? May help.)
The Price of Ingenuity#480.dst: Los resultados preliminares indican un aprovechamiento de la energía mucho mejor y menos contaminación. (¿Aire más limpio? Puede ayudar.)

The Price of Ingenuity#482.src: Return to the Steel Feather through Yusanu's tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#482.dst: Vuelve a la Pluma de Acero por el túnel de Yusanu en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#483.src: ...what was that?! What were they DOING there?!
The Price of Ingenuity#483.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#484.src: I- I- I don't know! A surprise visit? I didn't... I didn't think...
The Price of Ingenuity#484.dst: ¡Y- y- yo qué sé! ¿Una visita sorpresa? No... no pensé...
The Price of Ingenuity#484.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#485.src: So, "letting off some steam", huh?! Oh, sure, bring Sovereign Zhiraok along with you!! Why not!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#485.dst: Así que, "desahogarse", ¡¿eh?! ¡¡Ah, claro, y de paso te traes al Soberano Zhiraok!! ¡¡¡Por qué no!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#485.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#486.src: We almost got caught! We- oh god, we... we almost got caught...
The Price of Ingenuity#486.dst: ¡Casi nos pillan! Nos- dios, casi... casi nos pillan...
The Price of Ingenuity#486.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#487.src: ...what are we doing? Why did- why did we do that? That was so...
The Price of Ingenuity#487.dst: ...¿qué estamos haciendo? ¿Por qué- por qué hemos hecho eso? Ha sido tan...
The Price of Ingenuity#487.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#488.src: You're asking ME?! Yeah, Rex, why did we do that?!
The Price of Ingenuity#488.dst: ¡¿Me lo preguntas a MÍ?! ¡Sí, Rex, ¿por qué lo hemos hecho?!
The Price of Ingenuity#488.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#489.src: Stop. Just... stop, for a second. I need to... think.
The Price of Ingenuity#489.dst: Para. Solo... para un segundo. Necesito... pensar.
The Price of Ingenuity#489.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#490.src: ...damn it. Damn it, damn it, damn it! Stupid, impulsive... ugh!!
The Price of Ingenuity#490.dst: ...maldita sea. ¡Maldita, maldita, maldita sea! Estúpida, impulsiva... ¡uf!
The Price of Ingenuity#490.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#492.src: No, I... I'm not. I'm sorry, I- I should know better by now...
The Price of Ingenuity#492.dst: No, no... no lo estoy. Lo siento, yo- ya debería saberlo...
The Price of Ingenuity#492.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#493.src: It... doesn't matter. It's too late to take it back. We can... we can use it as a trump card. Yusanu, please tell me you can figure out what it is.
The Price of Ingenuity#493.dst: Da... da igual. Ya no se puede deshacer. Podemos... podemos usarlo como as en la manga. Yusanu, dime por favor que puedes averiguar qué es.
The Price of Ingenuity#493.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#494.src: I... I don't know. I never got to work too closely with it, so... I have no idea what it is. If I work with it, maybe I can get somewhere. But...
The Price of Ingenuity#494.dst: Yo... no lo sé. Nunca llegué a trabajar muy de cerca con él, así que... no tengo ni idea de qué es. Si lo estudio, quizá llegue a algo. Pero...
The Price of Ingenuity#494.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#495.src: Good enough, I guess. Come on, let's get back. I need to... find Mora. And you need to tell everyone what you've been up to.
The Price of Ingenuity#495.dst: Con eso me vale, supongo. Venga, volvamos. Necesito... encontrar a Mora. Y tú tienes que contarles a todos lo que has estado haciendo.
The Price of Ingenuity#495.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#496.src: You collectively decide that leaving Flowers be is probably best for everyone involved.
The Price of Ingenuity#496.dst: Entre todos decidís que dejar a Flowers en paz es probablemente lo mejor para todos.

The Price of Ingenuity#497.src: These vents are broken, and were blocked off for a reason. Proceeding further will be dangerous!
The Price of Ingenuity#497.dst: Estas rejillas están rotas y se cerraron por algo. ¡Seguir adelante será peligroso!

The Price of Ingenuity#498.src: ...so just hiding what we did today isn't an option?
The Price of Ingenuity#498.dst: ...¿entonces esconder lo que hemos hecho hoy no es una opción?
The Price of Ingenuity#498.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#499.src: And let it come back to bite us later down the line? No thanks. Let's go.
The Price of Ingenuity#499.dst: ¿Y que nos estalle en la cara más adelante? No, gracias. Vamos.
The Price of Ingenuity#499.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#500.src: Really, Rex, are you... alright? I don't think I've ever seen-
The Price of Ingenuity#500.dst: En serio, Rex, ¿estás... bien? Creo que nunca te había visto-
The Price of Ingenuity#500.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#501.src: Don't. Don't push it. Not right now.
The Price of Ingenuity#501.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#502.src: Hey! You three, where the heck have you been all day?!
The Price of Ingenuity#502.dst: ¡Eh! Vosotros tres, ¡¿dónde demonios habéis estado todo el día?!
The Price of Ingenuity#502.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#504.src: Yes, it's rather curious! I happened to speak to Syndra, and apparently there were no such "important tasks" assigned to you! She seemed rather clueless about the whole matter!
The Price of Ingenuity#504.dst: ¡Sí, es bastante curioso! Da la casualidad de que hablé con Syndra y, por lo visto, ¡no os asignó ninguna de esas "tareas importantes"! ¡Parecía no saber nada del asunto!
The Price of Ingenuity#504.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#506.src: You know what happened, Mora. I- I messed up. Again.
The Price of Ingenuity#506.dst: Sabes lo que ha pasado, Mora. La- la he liado. Otra vez.
The Price of Ingenuity#506.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#507.src: Huh? What do you mean, agai-
The Price of Ingenuity#507.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#508.src: Ah, Yuman, would you mind taking Yusanu along with you to go tell the others we'll be a little late to the meeting? I believe there will be some additional news today.
The Price of Ingenuity#508.dst: Ah, Yuman, ¿te importaría llevarte a Yusanu para decirles a los demás que llegaremos un poco tarde a la reunión? Creo que hoy habrá alguna noticia más.
The Price of Ingenuity#508.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#509.src: Uh... sure, I guess. Yus, can you tell me what's up while we walk?
The Price of Ingenuity#509.dst: Eh... claro, supongo. Yus, ¿me cuentas qué pasa mientras andamos?
The Price of Ingenuity#509.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#512.src: It's... bad. We stole something important from the Sovereign's workshop. It's... a long story. Yusanu should tell his part of it. But...
The Price of Ingenuity#512.dst: Es... malo. Robamos algo importante del taller de la Soberana. Es... una larga historia. Yusanu debería contar su parte. Pero...
The Price of Ingenuity#512.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#513.src: I see. I apologize, Rex, I should have been more attentive.
The Price of Ingenuity#513.dst: Entiendo. Lo siento, Rex, debería haber estado más atento.
The Price of Ingenuity#513.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#514.src: No! No, it's not your fault, I should have- I should have known I was being impulsive, I... I wasn't thinking straight.
The Price of Ingenuity#514.dst: ¡No! No, no es culpa tuya, debería haber- debería haber visto que estaba siendo impulsiva, yo... no pensaba con claridad.
The Price of Ingenuity#514.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#515.src: Ah. Of course, you don't know. I should have informed you the last time this happened...
The Price of Ingenuity#515.dst: Ah. Claro, tú no lo sabes. Debí informarte la última vez que ocurrió...
The Price of Ingenuity#515.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#516.src: Rex has these... ah, "moods," sometimes, wherein she gets... overly excitable and impulsive. Many a time have they led her into trouble.
The Price of Ingenuity#516.dst: Rex tiene a veces estos... ah, "arrebatos", en los que se pone... demasiado exaltada e impulsiva. Más de una vez la han metido en problemas.
The Price of Ingenuity#516.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#517.src: Ugh, I should know better by now! Especially here, especially now, when...
The Price of Ingenuity#517.dst: ¡Uf, ya debería saberlo! Sobre todo aquí, sobre todo ahora, cuando...
The Price of Ingenuity#517.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#518.src: Well, what is done is done, and nevertheless, we must press on. Let's join the others for the meeting. Syndra has something important to tell us.
The Price of Ingenuity#518.dst: Bueno, lo hecho, hecho está, y aun así debemos seguir adelante. Vayamos con los demás a la reunión. Syndra tiene algo importante que contarnos.
The Price of Ingenuity#518.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#519.src: Attend the meeting in the Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#519.dst: Asiste a la reunión en la Pluma de Acero en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#520.src: There you are! Mora, Rex, what's going-
The Price of Ingenuity#520.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#521.src: Syndra, I believe that can wait. We've, ah, held up dinner long enough, I believe. If everyone is here, we should begin. First- Yusanu, what was it you had to tell us?
The Price of Ingenuity#521.dst: Syndra, creo que eso puede esperar. Ya, ah, hemos retrasado bastante la cena. Si estamos todos, deberíamos empezar. Primero- Yusanu, ¿qué era lo que tenías que contarnos?
The Price of Ingenuity#521.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#522.src: ...sigh. Before I begin, I need to make it clear- I was doing what I thought was best for the Steel Feather.
The Price of Ingenuity#522.dst: ...suspiro. Antes de empezar, quiero dejarlo claro- hacía lo que creía mejor para la Pluma de Acero.
The Price of Ingenuity#522.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#523.src: Yeah, man, good start... really instills confidence.
The Price of Ingenuity#523.dst: Ya, tío, buen comienzo... da mucha confianza.
The Price of Ingenuity#523.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#524.src: Yuman, please... let me get through this. Don't interrupt.
The Price of Ingenuity#524.dst: Yuman, por favor... déjame terminar. No me interrumpas.
The Price of Ingenuity#524.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#525.src: So. So, so,so... The... the reason the crown has left us alone down here is because I have been working with Sovereign Soosu.
The Price of Ingenuity#525.dst: Así que. Así que, así que,así que... La... la razón de que la Corona nos haya dejado en paz aquí abajo es que he estado trabajando con la Soberana Soosu.
The Price of Ingenuity#525.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#527.src: The reason we've been able to stay under the radar for so long is because of this, Yulie.
The Price of Ingenuity#527.dst: La razón de que hayamos pasado desapercibidos tanto tiempo es esta, Yulie.
The Price of Ingenuity#527.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#528.src: The reason we can live here, leave our home, make use of the city's electricity... it's because of my collaboration.
The Price of Ingenuity#528.dst: La razón de que podamos vivir aquí, salir de casa, usar la electricidad de la ciudad... es mi colaboración.
The Price of Ingenuity#528.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#529.src: She said she saw potential in me. Told me that if I helped her in her workshops, then... then you all would be safe down here.
The Price of Ingenuity#529.dst: Dijo que veía potencial en mí. Me dijo que si la ayudaba en sus talleres, entonces... entonces todos vosotros estaríais a salvo aquí abajo.
The Price of Ingenuity#529.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#530.src: I didn't tell anybody because I knew you wouldn't get it. You'd think it was stupid, and risky, and a bad idea. Working with... with someone responsible for our problems.
The Price of Ingenuity#530.dst: No se lo dije a nadie porque sabía que no lo entenderíais. Pensaríais que era estúpido, arriesgado y mala idea. Trabajar con... con alguien responsable de nuestros problemas.
The Price of Ingenuity#530.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#531.src: And I knew it was risky. I did. But I thought that if I were to mess up, only I would be punished. You all would be safe.
The Price of Ingenuity#531.dst: Y sabía que era arriesgado. Lo sabía. Pero pensé que si metía la pata, solo me castigarían a mí. Vosotros estaríais a salvo.
The Price of Ingenuity#531.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#532.src: ...now. I understand emotions are running high right now. I would ask everyone to take a step back, think through it logically, and remain c-
The Price of Ingenuity#532.dst: ...veamos. Entiendo que los ánimos están muy alterados ahora mismo. Pediría a todos que den un paso atrás, lo piensen con lógica y mantengan la cal-
The Price of Ingenuity#532.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#533.src: Are you insane, Yusanu?! Of all the secrets you could have been keeping-
The Price of Ingenuity#533.dst: ¡¿Estás loco, Yusanu?! De todos los secretos que podías guardar-
The Price of Ingenuity#533.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#535.src: No, I don't think I will! Is that what the alarms were about? How long has this been going on? What was running through your head when you decided-
The Price of Ingenuity#535.dst: ¡No, creo que no! ¿Por eso eran las alarmas? ¿Cuánto tiempo lleva esto? ¿Qué se te pasaba por la cabeza cuando decidiste-
The Price of Ingenuity#535.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#536.src: As if you haven't been doing the same thing this whole time! Trying to put all the weight on your own shoulders, not getting help from anyone else!!
The Price of Ingenuity#536.dst: ¡Como si tú no llevaras haciendo lo mismo todo este tiempo! ¡¡Cargándotelo todo a los hombros, sin dejar que nadie te ayude!!
The Price of Ingenuity#536.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#537.src: So- so, y'know, I'm a little mad. He should have talked to us about it! But... he's telling us now. He's asking for help now.
The Price of Ingenuity#537.dst: Así que- así que, ¿sabes?, estoy un poco enfadado. ¡Debería habérnoslo contado! Pero... nos lo cuenta ahora. Ahora pide ayuda.
The Price of Ingenuity#537.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#540.src: After yesterday's run-in with the soldiers... Soosu is demanding I hand over whoever's responsible. I... I can't do that.
The Price of Ingenuity#540.dst: Después del encontronazo de ayer con los soldados... Soosu exige que entregue al responsable. Yo... no puedo hacerlo.
The Price of Ingenuity#540.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#541.src: Rex and {u} caught me talking to her today. That's why... that's why I'm telling you.
The Price of Ingenuity#541.dst: Rex y {u} me pillaron hoy hablando con ella. Por eso... por eso os lo cuento.
The Price of Ingenuity#541.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#542.src: ...yeah. I convinced him to stop working with her, and to tell you all about it.
The Price of Ingenuity#542.dst: ...sí. Le convencí de dejar de trabajar con ella y de contároslo todo.
The Price of Ingenuity#542.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#543.src: We also... stole an important gadget she and Yusanu were working on. Something the Queen was very invested in.
The Price of Ingenuity#543.dst: También... robamos un aparato importante en el que trabajaban ella y Yusanu. Algo en lo que la Reina tenía mucho interés.
The Price of Ingenuity#543.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#544.src: I don't know what it is or what it does. I don't know what it's for. All I know is that the Queen needs it finished. It's all she's had Soosu working on for... months.
The Price of Ingenuity#544.dst: No sé qué es ni qué hace. No sé para qué sirve. Solo sé que la Reina necesita que se termine. Es lo único en lo que ha tenido a Soosu trabajando... durante meses.
The Price of Ingenuity#544.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#545.src: I'll try to figure out what it is in my spare time. Maybe it'll help us! I... hope it will.
The Price of Ingenuity#545.dst: Intentaré averiguar qué es en mis ratos libres. ¡Quizá nos ayude! Yo... espero que sí.
The Price of Ingenuity#545.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#546.src: Yulie, Yuman... I owe you a better apology. I can talk to you in private later, but... right now, we should continue with the meeting.
The Price of Ingenuity#546.dst: Yulie, Yuman... os debo una disculpa mejor. Puedo hablar con vosotros en privado luego, pero... ahora deberíamos seguir con la reunión.
The Price of Ingenuity#546.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#548.src: ...that was certainly a lot. Fortunately, angering the Sovereign may not ultimately matter. If all goes according to plan... the crown will fall at the end of the festival.
The Price of Ingenuity#548.dst: ...desde luego ha sido mucho. Por suerte, enfadar a la Soberana puede acabar dando igual. Si todo sale según lo previsto... la Corona caerá al final del festival.
The Price of Ingenuity#548.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#549.src: My goal, as always, has been to find a way to destroy the crown's influence and to free our province. I believe this upcoming festival is an opportunity to do just that.
The Price of Ingenuity#549.dst: Mi objetivo, como siempre, ha sido encontrar la forma de destruir la influencia de la Corona y liberar nuestra provincia. Creo que este festival es la oportunidad de hacerlo.
The Price of Ingenuity#549.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#550.src: During the Crown Festival, Her Majesty will die.
The Price of Ingenuity#550.dst: Durante el Festival de la Corona, Su Majestad morirá.
The Price of Ingenuity#550.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#551.src: Settle down, everyone, settle down! Please, allow Syndra to continue.
The Price of Ingenuity#551.dst: ¡Calma, todos, calma! Por favor, dejad que Syndra continúe.
The Price of Ingenuity#551.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#552.src: It will not be easy. But if we strike when her guard is down, and catch her by surprise, I believe it is possible.
The Price of Ingenuity#552.dst: No será fácil. Pero si atacamos cuando baje la guardia y la cogemos por sorpresa, creo que es posible.
The Price of Ingenuity#552.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#553.src: I'll be splitting you all into several groups, and will assign tasks that must be completed before the festival.
The Price of Ingenuity#553.dst: Os dividiré en varios grupos y os asignaré tareas que hay que completar antes del festival.
The Price of Ingenuity#553.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#554.src: The decision Quill and I have come to is that I alone will be going for the kill. That way, if anything goes wrong... no one else faces the consequences.
The Price of Ingenuity#554.dst: La decisión a la que hemos llegado Quill y yo es que iré yo sola a matarla. Así, si algo sale mal... nadie más afronta las consecuencias.
The Price of Ingenuity#554.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#555.src: I'll go over the details tomorrow. I think... we've had enough excitement today. Please, hold your complaints until then, as well.
The Price of Ingenuity#555.dst: Mañana repasaré los detalles. Creo que... hoy ya hemos tenido bastante emoción. Por favor, guardad también vuestras quejas hasta entonces.
The Price of Ingenuity#555.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#556.src: Ahem. Yes, indeed. I suppose we should be getting to dinner, as well.
The Price of Ingenuity#556.dst: Ejem. Sí, desde luego. Supongo que también deberíamos ir a cenar.
The Price of Ingenuity#556.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#557.src: Yuman... this may be unfair of me to ask, but would you be willing to play us a song tonight? We will not have many days left together.
The Price of Ingenuity#557.dst: Yuman... quizá sea injusto pedírtelo, pero ¿te importaría tocarnos una canción esta noche? No nos quedan muchos días juntos.
The Price of Ingenuity#557.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#558.src: Yeah... yeah, man, of course. I can do that.
The Price of Ingenuity#558.dst: Sí... sí, tío, claro. Puedo hacerlo.
The Price of Ingenuity#558.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#559.src: Then let us enjoy the remainder of our company!
The Price of Ingenuity#559.dst: ¡Entonces disfrutemos de la compañía que nos queda!
The Price of Ingenuity#559.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#560.dst: Mira la actuación de Yuman en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#561.src: Hey, everyone! Man, uh... small crowd today, huh?
The Price of Ingenuity#561.dst: ¡Hola a todos! Tío, eh... poco público hoy, ¿eh?
The Price of Ingenuity#561.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#562.src: Oh, man, is that Jiro I see? Hey, man! I didn't, uh... expect to see ya.
The Price of Ingenuity#562.dst: ¡Oh, tío! ¿Ese es Jiro? ¡Eh, tío! No, eh... no esperaba verte.
The Price of Ingenuity#562.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#564.src: Uh, just, you didn't seem super happy with me after... after yesterday. With the- soldier thing.
The Price of Ingenuity#564.dst: Eh, es que no parecías muy contento conmigo después de... después de ayer. Con lo de- los soldados.
The Price of Ingenuity#564.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#565.src: ... Oh! Yeah. No worries. Water under the bridge.
The Price of Ingenuity#565.dst: ... ¡Oh! Ya. No pasa nada. Agua pasada.
The Price of Ingenuity#565.speaker: Jiro

The Price of Ingenuity#566.src: If... if you say so! Don't think you've heard this one before, so tell me how you like it!
The Price of Ingenuity#566.dst: Si... ¡si tú lo dices! Creo que esta no la has oído, ¡así que dime qué te parece!
The Price of Ingenuity#566.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#567.src: But first... Yus. Yusanu. Look, I... I'm not one to hold grudges. So I don't need any more apologies from you! I get it.
The Price of Ingenuity#567.dst: Pero primero... Yus. Yusanu. Mira, yo... no soy rencoroso. ¡Así que no necesito más disculpas tuyas! Lo entiendo.
The Price of Ingenuity#567.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#568.src: I just... want you to trust us more, 'kay? You and Yulie both, haha! 'Cause... I want to help!
The Price of Ingenuity#568.dst: Solo... quiero que confíes más en nosotros, ¿vale? ¡Tú y Yulie, jaja! Porque... ¡yo quiero ayudar!
The Price of Ingenuity#568.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#569.src: I had a think, and yeah. It sucks you didn't tell us. But your deal with Soosu- it saved us! Gave us a home, gave us a future!
The Price of Ingenuity#569.dst: Le he dado vueltas, y sí. Es una faena que no nos lo contaras. Pero tu trato con Soosu- ¡nos salvó! ¡Nos dio un hogar, nos dio un futuro!
The Price of Ingenuity#569.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#570.src: So... this song's dedicated to you. Hope you like it.
The Price of Ingenuity#570.dst: Así que... esta canción va dedicada a ti. Espero que te guste.
The Price of Ingenuity#570.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#571.src: No... no no no no no, where is it, where IS IT?! I can't... I need to find it, I-
The Price of Ingenuity#571.dst: No... no no no no, ¿dónde está? ¡¿DÓNDE ESTÁ?! Tengo que encontrarlo, yo-
The Price of Ingenuity#571.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#573.src: EEP! Y- your Majesty, I- I- I wasn't expecting you until... tomorrow. Wh- what're you doing here?
The Price of Ingenuity#573.dst: ¡IIP! S- Su Majestad, n- n- no la esperaba hasta... mañana. ¿Q- qué hace aquí?
The Price of Ingenuity#573.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#574.src: My schedule freed up, so I decided to check in early. Is something wrong, Sovereign?
The Price of Ingenuity#574.dst: Se me ha liberado la agenda y he decidido venir antes. ¿Ocurre algo, Soberana?
The Price of Ingenuity#574.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#576.src: Don't bother. How incompetent must you be, to have lost it from your own workshop?!
The Price of Ingenuity#576.dst: No te molestes. ¡¿Cómo de incompetente hay que ser para perderlo en tu propio taller?!
The Price of Ingenuity#576.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#577.src: I- I- I don't understand how, my golems haven't been disturbed! They didn't detect anything!
The Price of Ingenuity#577.dst: N- n- no entiendo cómo, ¡a mis gólems no los ha tocado nadie! ¡No detectaron nada!
The Price of Ingenuity#577.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#578.src: Perhaps if you focused more on efficiency instead of playing around with your toys, this could have been prevented.
The Price of Ingenuity#578.dst: Quizá, si te centraras más en la eficiencia en vez de jugar con tus juguetes, esto se podría haber evitado.
The Price of Ingenuity#578.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#579.src: I'll- I'll fix this, I promise! I promise I promise I promise, I can fix it! I can... I can restart! I still have all the research notes, and I-
The Price of Ingenuity#579.dst: Lo- ¡lo arreglaré, lo prometo! ¡Lo prometo lo prometo lo prometo, puedo arreglarlo! ¡Puedo... puedo empezar de nuevo! Tengo todas las notas, y yo-
The Price of Ingenuity#579.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#580.src: Enough. I have been lenient with your performance maintaining your district, because I had faith there would be results.
The Price of Ingenuity#580.dst: Basta. He sido indulgente con tu gestión del distrito porque confiaba en que habría resultados.
The Price of Ingenuity#580.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#581.src: Restarting the Resonance Weaver project... it cannot be done. That artifact I entrusted you with... that magic is a lost art. It cannot be replicated.
The Price of Ingenuity#581.dst: Reiniciar el proyecto del Tejedor de Resonancia... no se puede. Ese artefacto que te confié... esa magia es un arte perdido. No se puede replicar.
The Price of Ingenuity#581.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#582.src: N- no, I have the notes, I- I know how it works, I can do it, just- just give me a chance! I can fix this!
The Price of Ingenuity#582.dst: N- no, tengo las notas, s- sé cómo funciona, puedo hacerlo, solo- ¡solo deme una oportunidad! ¡Puedo arreglarlo!
The Price of Ingenuity#582.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#583.src: I must prepare for the festival. I will expect your presence there, as usual. Please... clean yourself up before that.
The Price of Ingenuity#583.dst: Debo prepararme para el festival. Espero tu presencia allí, como siempre. Por favor... aséate antes.
The Price of Ingenuity#583.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#586.src: Consider our agreement null. You have failed me. You will continue your service as Sovereign indefinitely... with your blessing intact.
The Price of Ingenuity#586.dst: Considera nuestro acuerdo nulo. Me has fallado. Seguirás sirviendo como Soberana indefinidamente... con tu bendición intacta.
The Price of Ingenuity#586.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#587.src: ...what? No- no, no no no, you- you can't, you can't, you can't!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#587.dst: ...¿qué? No- no, no no no, ¡¡¡¡no puede, no puede, no puede!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#587.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#589.src: Rest for the night in your room in the Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Price of Ingenuity#589.dst: Descansa durante la noche en tu habitación de la Pluma de Acero en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Price of Ingenuity#591.src: You all go and meet up, now. I have much to discuss with Quill.
The Price of Ingenuity#591.dst: Venga, id a reuniros con ellos. Tengo mucho que hablar con Quill.
The Price of Ingenuity#591.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#592.src: Training's a pretty good option, all things considered. Let's go before I forget how to string my bow!
The Price of Ingenuity#592.dst: Entrenar no es mala opción, bien pensado. ¡Vamos antes de que se me olvide cómo encordar el arco!
The Price of Ingenuity#592.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#593.src: Mmmmm. That bread was really tasty...
The Price of Ingenuity#593.dst: Mmmmm. Qué rico estaba ese pan...
The Price of Ingenuity#593.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#594.src: Maybe once we're done training, I should bake another loaf...
The Price of Ingenuity#594.dst: Quizá cuando acabemos de entrenar debería hornear otra hogaza...
The Price of Ingenuity#594.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#595.src: The re- reason I got to bed s- so- so late tonight was be- because I'd been up late tr- training...
The Price of Ingenuity#595.dst: La r- razón de que me acostara t- tan- tan tarde anoche fue p- porque estuve hasta tarde entr- entrenando...
The Price of Ingenuity#595.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#596.src: I only ha- have a f- fl- flicker of magic... I don't want it to sn- snuff out.
The Price of Ingenuity#596.dst: Solo t- tengo un d- de- destello de magia... No quiero que se ap- apague.
The Price of Ingenuity#596.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#597.src: Ah, to train first thing in the morning!
The Price of Ingenuity#597.dst: ¡Ah, entrenar a primera hora de la mañana!
The Price of Ingenuity#597.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#598.src: It's no smithing, perhaps, but still a fantastic way to work up a sweat!
The Price of Ingenuity#598.dst: No será la herrería, quizá, ¡pero sigue siendo una forma estupenda de sudar!
The Price of Ingenuity#598.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#599.src: If you're reading this note, please turn around!
The Price of Ingenuity#599.dst: Si estás leyendo esta nota, ¡da media vuelta!

The Price of Ingenuity#603.src: Sources of Energy (Solar, Hydro, Geo) - Soosu
The Price of Ingenuity#603.dst: Fuentes de energía (solar, hidráulica, geotérmica) - Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#604.src: The Daily Life of a Princess
The Price of Ingenuity#604.dst: La vida cotidiana de una princesa

The Price of Ingenuity#605.src: The Exploration of Magnetic Fields - Soosu
The Price of Ingenuity#605.dst: La exploración de los campos magnéticos - Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#606.src: Adventures of Sparkles the Unicorn - Soosu
The Price of Ingenuity#606.dst: Las aventuras del unicornio Sparkles - Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#608.src: Sneak through the mansion avoiding guards.
The Price of Ingenuity#608.dst: Cuélate por la mansión evitando a los guardias.

The Price of Ingenuity#609.src: The {p} has gone through multiple irrigation methods over the years.
The Price of Ingenuity#609.dst: {p} ha pasado por diversos métodos de riego a lo largo de los años.

The Price of Ingenuity#610.src: At first, farmland was watered manually, later shifting to animals carrying larger water tanks.
The Price of Ingenuity#610.dst: Al principio, las tierras de cultivo se regaban a mano; más tarde se pasó a animales que cargaban depósitos de agua más grandes.

The Price of Ingenuity#611.src: Of course, it was my first iteration that began our district's progress. It utilized a network of pipes pulling water directly from the rivers, and distributing it on a timed schedule.
The Price of Ingenuity#611.dst: Por supuesto, fue mi primera versión la que puso en marcha el progreso de nuestro distrito. Usaba una red de tuberías que tomaba el agua directamente de los ríos y la distribuía según un horario.

The Price of Ingenuity#612.src: After ascending to my position, I continued innovating on the design, in order to...
The Price of Ingenuity#612.dst: Tras ascender a mi cargo, seguí innovando en el diseño para...

The Price of Ingenuity#613.src: The book keeps going on and on about minor tweaks made to irrigation, detailing every single design. You decide to stop reading.
The Price of Ingenuity#613.dst: El libro sigue y sigue con pequeños ajustes al riego, detallando todos y cada uno de los diseños. Decides dejar de leer.

The Price of Ingenuity#614.src: I have recently begun development on an alternative design, utilizing electricity as the primary source of energy.
The Price of Ingenuity#614.dst: Hace poco empecé a desarrollar un diseño alternativo que usa la electricidad como fuente principal de energía.

The Price of Ingenuity#615.src: This book appears empty... Touching it made an odd noise.
The Price of Ingenuity#615.dst: Este libro parece vacío... Al tocarlo ha hecho un ruido extraño.

The Price of Ingenuity#617.src: On my latest reread (the {~}th exactly, by my count), I noted the girl's ability to transport between two coordinates. It was an ability some of my colleagues could replicate through their blessings.
The Price of Ingenuity#617.dst: En mi última relectura (la número {~} exactamente, según mis cuentas), me fijé en la capacidad de la chica para transportarse entre dos coordenadas. Era una capacidad que algunos de mis colegas podían replicar con sus bendiciones.

The Price of Ingenuity#618.src: I've always envied them. It seems a much better blessing than the stupid one I received, I can't stop, I hate it I hate it I ha
The Price of Ingenuity#618.dst: Siempre los he envidiado. Parece una bendición mucho mejor que la estúpida que recibí yo, no puedo parar, la odio la odio la od

The Price of Ingenuity#619.src: So I decided to design my own device. Less practical, maybe, but far more creative! If I could transfer a person's matter *exactly*, element by element, precise positioning intact...
The Price of Ingenuity#619.dst: Así que decidí diseñar mi propio aparato. Menos práctico, quizá, ¡pero mucho más creativo! Si pudiera trasladar la materia de una persona *exactamente*, elemento por elemento, con su posición precisa intacta...

The Price of Ingenuity#620.src: I'll be trying it on my golems first! Just in case.
The Price of Ingenuity#620.dst: ¡Lo probaré primero con mis gólems! Por si acaso.

The Price of Ingenuity#621.src: Status: Why why why why why why why?! Why did you think it would work?! Of course nothing good can come of this, of co Cancelled
The Price of Ingenuity#621.dst: Estado: ¡¿Por qué por qué por qué por qué por qué por qué por qué?! ¡¿Por qué creías que funcionaría?! Pues claro que de esto no puede salir nada bueno, pues cl Cancelado

The Price of Ingenuity#622.src: It's an old diary. There's a lot of entries... where do you want to start?
The Price of Ingenuity#622.dst: Es un diario antiguo. Hay muchas entradas... ¿por dónde quieres empezar?

The Price of Ingenuity#623.src: It hurt. A lot. But I got through it, because I'm a big girl, and it was important.
The Price of Ingenuity#623.dst: Dolió. Mucho. Pero lo superé, porque ya soy mayorcita, y era importante.

The Price of Ingenuity#624.src: I got my blessing! It's... everything I could have ever dreamed of, and more. I can do so much now- I can get through my plans for the district so much more quickly.
The Price of Ingenuity#624.dst: ¡Ya tengo mi bendición! Es... todo lo que podría haber soñado, y más. Ahora puedo hacer muchísimo- puedo sacar adelante mis planes para el distrito mucho más rápido.

The Price of Ingenuity#625.src: Her Majesty wants to rename the district, to better align with its future... nothing like this has happened since the Penitence District was established, so it's a big deal.
The Price of Ingenuity#625.dst: Su Majestad quiere cambiarle el nombre al distrito, para que encaje mejor con su futuro... no pasaba nada así desde que se fundó el Distrito de la Penitencia, así que es algo muy gordo.

The Price of Ingenuity#626.src: And so, I'm now Sovereign of the {p}! My job is to expand production and raise efficiency, however I see fit.
The Price of Ingenuity#626.dst: ¡Y así, ahora soy la Soberana de {p}! Mi trabajo es ampliar la producción y aumentar la eficiencia, como mejor me parezca.

The Price of Ingenuity#627.src: I can better support my family, too... Amastli was only supporting my uncle, but I have authority now, so I can support the others as well. It feels... good. They won't have to struggle anymore.
The Price of Ingenuity#627.dst: También puedo ayudar mejor a mi familia... Amastli solo mantenía a mi tío, pero ahora tengo autoridad, así que puedo mantener también a los demás. Se siente... bien. Ya no tendrán que pasar apuros.

The Price of Ingenuity#628.src: When I'm done, I hope no one else will have to, either. I'll make things better. I will.
The Price of Ingenuity#628.dst: Cuando termine, espero que nadie más tenga que pasarlos tampoco. Haré que las cosas mejoren. Lo haré.

The Price of Ingenuity#629.src: Who was I, back then? Where did she go?
The Price of Ingenuity#629.dst: ¿Quién era yo, entonces? ¿Adónde se fue ella?

The Price of Ingenuity#630.src: I have all these resources at my disposal, I can build and tinker to my heart's content, and- it's fun, it is, so why... why do I feel this way?
The Price of Ingenuity#630.dst: Tengo todos estos recursos a mi disposición, puedo construir y trastear cuanto quiera, y- es divertido, lo es, así que ¿por qué... por qué me siento así?

The Price of Ingenuity#631.src: My only limit is my imagination! If I put my mind to it, I can make anything!
The Price of Ingenuity#631.dst: ¡Mi único límite es mi imaginación! ¡Si me lo propongo, puedo hacer cualquier cosa!

The Price of Ingenuity#632.src: I've made incredible progress on infrastructure, on machinery to make peoples' lives easier, better, so why...
The Price of Ingenuity#632.dst: He hecho avances increíbles en infraestructura, en máquinas que hacen la vida de la gente más fácil, mejor, así que ¿por qué...

The Price of Ingenuity#633.src: Why does everything feel so gray?
The Price of Ingenuity#633.dst: ¿Por qué todo se siente tan gris?

The Price of Ingenuity#634.src: ...I turned {~}, yesterday. Three years flew past, and I hardly felt them. Her Majesty is finally letting me start taking the Wellspring water.
The Price of Ingenuity#634.dst: ...Ayer cumplí {~}. Tres años pasaron volando, y apenas los noté. Su Majestad por fin me deja empezar a tomar el agua del Wellspring.

The Price of Ingenuity#635.src: You're not really supposed to drink too much of it. I tried anyway. It didn't taste like anything.
The Price of Ingenuity#635.dst: En realidad no se debe beber demasiada. Lo intenté igualmente. No sabía a nada.

The Price of Ingenuity#636.src: It just looks like normal water, if a bit more concentrated. The same ratios of elements, the same composition and ordering, but... more.
The Price of Ingenuity#636.dst: Parece agua normal, aunque algo más concentrada. Las mismas proporciones de elementos, la misma composición y el mismo orden, pero... más.

The Price of Ingenuity#637.src: I... don't know where I was going with this. I don't know how to write these entries anymore. I don't know.
The Price of Ingenuity#637.dst: Yo... no sé adónde quería llegar con esto. Ya no sé cómo escribir estas entradas. No lo sé.

The Price of Ingenuity#638.src: It was peaceful. Slipped away in her sleep. She lived a full life, they said, but she wasn't... supposed to be gone so soon.
The Price of Ingenuity#638.dst: Fue en paz. Se fue mientras dormía. Tuvo una vida plena, dijeron, pero no... debía irse tan pronto.

The Price of Ingenuity#639.src: They never figured out what it was that she had. But I knew. I could see it. I didn't have a name for what it was. But I know its composition. I know its symptoms. I could point it out if I ever saw it again.
The Price of Ingenuity#639.dst: Nunca descubrieron qué era lo que tenía. Pero yo lo sabía. Lo veía. No tenía un nombre para ello. Pero conozco su composición. Conozco sus síntomas. Podría señalarlo si alguna vez volviera a verlo.

The Price of Ingenuity#640.src: Seeing her, lying there in the casket... I felt like I was barely present. All I could think, was... she looks the same as she always did.
The Price of Ingenuity#640.dst: Al verla ahí, tendida en el ataúd... sentí que apenas estaba presente. Lo único que podía pensar era... que tenía el mismo aspecto de siempre.

The Price of Ingenuity#641.src: Even when she was gone... when all that remained was her body... I couldn't even tell the difference.
The Price of Ingenuity#641.dst: Incluso cuando ya no estaba... cuando lo único que quedaba era su cuerpo... ni siquiera notaba la diferencia.

The Price of Ingenuity#643.src: Father and Uncle cried. They told stories I'd never heard. Everyone there shared their grief, their love.
The Price of Ingenuity#643.dst: Papá y el tío lloraron. Contaron historias que yo nunca había oído. Todos los presentes compartieron su dolor, su amor.

The Price of Ingenuity#646.src: I used to reread these when I felt lonely. I would try and imagine myself as that young, hopeful girl, still full of joy and hope.
The Price of Ingenuity#646.dst: Antes releía esto cuando me sentía sola. Intentaba imaginarme como aquella niña joven y esperanzada, todavía llena de alegría y esperanza.

The Price of Ingenuity#647.src: But I can't. A blessing built around my imagination, and I can't even do this one, STUPID THING?!
The Price of Ingenuity#647.dst: Pero no puedo. Una bendición construida en torno a mi imaginación, ¡¿y ni siquiera puedo hacer esta única y ESTÚPIDA COSA?!

The Price of Ingenuity#648.src: Everyone is growing older, except for me. Uncle passed last year. Father likely doesn't have long left either. Fiona and I grow more and more distant with each and every year.
The Price of Ingenuity#648.dst: Todos envejecen, menos yo. El tío murió el año pasado. Seguramente a papá tampoco le queda mucho. Fiona y yo nos distanciamos más y más con cada año que pasa.

The Price of Ingenuity#649.src: I lost her. That little girl. One day she was here, and the next, it was like she was never there at all.
The Price of Ingenuity#649.dst: La perdí. A aquella niña. Un día estaba aquí, y al siguiente era como si nunca hubiera existido.

The Price of Ingenuity#650.src: I'm sorry. I'm so, so, sorry.
The Price of Ingenuity#650.dst: Lo siento. Lo siento tanto, tanto.

The Price of Ingenuity#651.src: I found my old doll, Flowers. I thought I'd lost him years ago, and it turns out he was hiding in Uncle's old workshop!
The Price of Ingenuity#651.dst: He encontrado mi viejo muñeco, Flowers. Creía que lo había perdido hace años, ¡y resulta que estaba escondido en el viejo taller del tío!

The Price of Ingenuity#662.src: Construction was ongoing at the site, and I had to- it doesn't matter. They'll build over it, instead of tearing it down.
The Price of Ingenuity#662.dst: Había obras en el lugar, y tuve que- da igual. Construirán encima, en vez de derribarlo.

The Price of Ingenuity#663.src: But I found him. Physical proof of who I was. And... with my blessing, I could make him real!
The Price of Ingenuity#663.dst: Pero lo encontré. Una prueba física de quién era yo. Y... ¡con mi bendición, podía hacerlo real!

The Price of Ingenuity#664.src: I always dreamed of bringing him to life, so I could have another friend! So Fiona and I could ride on his back, and go on adventures, and...
The Price of Ingenuity#664.dst: ¡Siempre soñé con darle vida, para tener otro amigo! Para que Fiona y yo pudiéramos montar en su lomo, y vivir aventuras, y...

The Price of Ingenuity#665.src: ...and I remembered. For a moment, I remembered how I felt back then! For the first time in so, SO long, I felt... happy.
The Price of Ingenuity#665.dst: ...y lo recordé. ¡Por un momento recordé cómo me sentía entonces! Por primera vez en muchísimo, MUCHÍSIMO tiempo, me sentí... feliz.

The Price of Ingenuity#666.src: I want to feel like that again.

The Price of Ingenuity#667.src: My golems are my lifeline. Flowers was the first, grown from the soil of my youth... and the others followed suit.
The Price of Ingenuity#667.dst: Mis gólems son mi salvavidas. Flowers fue el primero, nacido de la tierra de mi infancia... y los demás le siguieron.

The Price of Ingenuity#668.src: From now on, I will only make the things I want. I've spent decades building up this district, trapped in pursuit of efficiency above all else, and where did that get me?
The Price of Ingenuity#668.dst: A partir de ahora, solo haré las cosas que yo quiera. He pasado décadas levantando este distrito, atrapada en la búsqueda de la eficiencia por encima de todo, ¿y adónde me ha llevado eso?

The Price of Ingenuity#669.src: I still love butterflies, sparkles, and flowers! I'd forgotten for a while, but I won't forget again.
The Price of Ingenuity#669.dst: ¡Me siguen encantando las mariposas, los destellos y las flores! Lo había olvidado durante un tiempo, pero no volveré a olvidarlo.

The Price of Ingenuity#670.src: I will make my mark on this world. I swear it.
The Price of Ingenuity#670.dst: Dejaré mi huella en este mundo. Lo juro.

The Price of Ingenuity#671.src: You've reached the end of the section. What will you read next?
The Price of Ingenuity#671.dst: Has llegado al final de la sección. ¿Qué leerás ahora?

The Price of Ingenuity#672.src: On the very first page of the diary, you find a crude drawing of a family.
The Price of Ingenuity#672.dst: En la primera página del diario encuentras un dibujo tosco de una familia.

The Price of Ingenuity#673.src: Two parents hold hands, labeled Ma and Pa. To the side of the mother stands another man, labeled "Uncle T." In front of them, a young girl with pigtails (labeled "me!!!") is holding hands with a slightly older girl (labeled "Fiona").
The Price of Ingenuity#673.dst: Dos adultos se dan la mano, rotulados Mamá y Papá. Junto a la madre hay otro hombre, rotulado "Tío T". Delante de ellos, una niña con coletas (rotulada "¡¡¡yo!!!") da la mano a otra niña algo mayor (rotulada "Fiona").

The Price of Ingenuity#675.src: I know Ma and Pa gotta work, I do!! But it's so booooring during the day... at least Uncle T does something INTERESTING.
The Price of Ingenuity#675.dst: ¡¡Ya sé que mamá y papá tienen que trabajar, que sí!! Pero es taaan aburrido durante el día... al menos el tío T hace algo INTERESANTE.

The Price of Ingenuity#676.src: He gets to make super AWESOME machines for the SOVEREIGN- ughh, it's so COOL!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#676.dst: Él hace máquinas súper GENIALES para el SOBERANO- ay, ¡¡¡qué GUAY!!!

The Price of Ingenuity#677.src: He's why we have a good house in the city, cause the Sovereign's an important guy, and so Uncle T is also important.
The Price of Ingenuity#677.dst: Gracias a él tenemos una buena casa en la ciudad, porque el Soberano es un tipo importante, y por eso el tío T también es importante.

The Price of Ingenuity#678.src: I don't super get how any of his stuff works... but, buuuut, maybe I'll get to learn! Best! Day! Ever!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#678.dst: No entiendo muy bien cómo funcionan sus cosas... pero, peeero, ¡quizá pueda aprender! ¡El! ¡Mejor! ¡¡¡Día!!!

The Price of Ingenuity#679.src: Slotted in between the pages, you find a crude drawing of a doll.
The Price of Ingenuity#679.dst: Entre las páginas encuentras un dibujo tosco de un muñeco.

The Price of Ingenuity#680.src: Its body is built of soil, and atop its head is a bright, colorful flower. In the margins of the page, someone has drawn many other kinds of flowers and plants.
The Price of Ingenuity#680.dst: Su cuerpo está hecho de tierra, y sobre la cabeza tiene una flor vistosa y colorida. En los márgenes de la página, alguien ha dibujado muchas otras clases de flores y plantas.

The Price of Ingenuity#681.src: He's so, so, cool. WAY cooler than Daruma (don't tell Fiona I said that, she'll get mad).
The Price of Ingenuity#681.dst: Es muy, muy guay. MUCHO más guay que Daruma (no le digas a Fiona que lo he dicho, se enfadará).

The Price of Ingenuity#682.src: Ma and Pa are still busy with work... but Uncle T's letting me hang out in the workshop more!!
The Price of Ingenuity#682.dst: Mamá y papá siguen ocupados con el trabajo... ¡¡pero el tío T me deja pasar más rato en el taller!!

The Price of Ingenuity#683.src: He even let me help him with a project!! Just screwing in some gears, but still... it's so so so awesome!!
The Price of Ingenuity#683.dst: ¡¡Hasta me dejó ayudarle con un proyecto!! Solo atornillar unos engranajes, pero aun así... ¡¡es súper súper súper genial!!

The Price of Ingenuity#684.src: I wish I could help her not be tired so much... oh, I know! What if I could build a machine to help??
The Price of Ingenuity#684.dst: Ojalá pudiera ayudarla a no estar tan cansada... ¡oh, ya sé! ¿¿Y si construyo una máquina que la ayude??

The Price of Ingenuity#685.src: So then she doesn't have to milk the cows all by herself, and we'll have time to play!
The Price of Ingenuity#685.dst: ¡Así no tendrá que ordeñar las vacas ella sola, y tendremos tiempo para jugar!

The Price of Ingenuity#686.src: A sketch of a machine to make milking cows easier. The lines are still rough, and the handwriting messy... but the dimensions seem meticulously measured, and everything is labeled appropriately.
The Price of Ingenuity#686.dst: Un boceto de una máquina para facilitar el ordeño. Los trazos aún son toscos y la letra, desordenada... pero las medidas parecen tomadas con meticulosidad, y todo está debidamente rotulado.

The Price of Ingenuity#687.src: He said the design was "genius" and "innovative" and "awesome" (okay, maybe I made that last one up), and pointed out some improvements I could make (I can't believe I missed them!!).
The Price of Ingenuity#687.dst: Dijo que el diseño era "brillante", "innovador" y "alucinante" (vale, quizá lo último me lo he inventado), y me señaló algunas mejoras que podía hacer (¡¡no me creo que se me pasaran!!).

The Price of Ingenuity#688.src: I'm gonna show my gift to Fiona tomorrow!
The Price of Ingenuity#688.dst: ¡Mañana le enseño mi regalo a Fiona!

The Price of Ingenuity#689.src: It worked super well too!!!! She got the cows milked in RECORD TIME, and we got to talk the whole time!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#689.dst: ¡¡¡¡Y funcionó súper bien!!!! ¡¡¡Ordeñó las vacas en un TIEMPO RÉCORD y estuvimos hablando todo el rato!!!

The Price of Ingenuity#690.src: We even had time to pick flowers near the old Wolie's farm! We haven't done that in MONTHS!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#690.dst: ¡Hasta tuvimos tiempo de coger flores cerca de la granja del viejo Wolie! ¡¡¡No lo hacíamos desde hacía MESES!!!

The Price of Ingenuity#691.src: It's stupid, it's hard, I'm always tired.... aaaahhhh!!!! I'm gonna EXPLODE!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#691.dst: Es una tontería, es duro, siempre estoy cansada.... ¡¡¡¡aaaahhhh!!!! ¡¡¡¡Voy a EXPLOTAR!!!!

The Price of Ingenuity#692.src: A drawing of an explosion. An arrow points at the center, labeled "me (in like a month!!!)."
The Price of Ingenuity#692.dst: Un dibujo de una explosión. Una flecha señala el centro, rotulada "yo (¡¡¡como dentro de un mes!!!)".

The Price of Ingenuity#693.src: I wish I could spend more time with Uncle T... I tried asking him, cause he's important, but he said he couldn't do anything about my assignment.... ughhhhh!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#693.dst: Ojalá pudiera pasar más tiempo con el tío T... Intenté pedírselo a él, porque es importante, pero dijo que no podía hacer nada con mi asignación de trabajo.... ¡¡¡¡uffffff!!!!

The Price of Ingenuity#694.src: And now Ma's gotten a little sick, so she can't do the hard stuff so much anymore, so I gotta pick up some of it, and- urgh!!!!! I wish the fields would just EXPLODE!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#694.dst: Y ahora mamá se ha puesto un poco enferma, así que ya no puede hacer tanto lo duro, así que me toca hacer parte, y- ¡¡¡¡¡argh!!!!! ¡¡¡Ojalá los campos EXPLOTARAN!!!

The Price of Ingenuity#695.src: A drawing of golden crop fields, exploding. An arrow points at the explosion, labeled "what I'm gonna do (if I gotta keep working!!!!!!)."
The Price of Ingenuity#695.dst: Un dibujo de campos de cultivo dorados, explotando. Una flecha señala la explosión, rotulada "lo que voy a hacer (¡¡¡¡¡¡si tengo que seguir trabajando!!!!!!)".

The Price of Ingenuity#696.src: There's gotta be a better way to do this stuff. If I had time to tinker, I bet I could figure something out...
The Price of Ingenuity#696.dst: Tiene que haber una forma mejor de hacer estas cosas. Si tuviera tiempo para trastear, seguro que se me ocurría algo...

The Price of Ingenuity#697.src: Machines are pretty awesome, right? If only they could do some of the work for us...
The Price of Ingenuity#697.dst: Las máquinas son bastante increíbles, ¿no? Si pudieran hacer parte del trabajo por nosotros...

The Price of Ingenuity#698.src: It turns out, if I wanna make a machine that helps farm stuff... I gotta learn about farming... okay, duh, obviously, but STILL. Bluh.
The Price of Ingenuity#698.dst: Resulta que, si quiero hacer una máquina que ayude con las cosas del campo... tengo que aprender sobre agricultura... vale, obvio, claro, pero AUN ASÍ. Puaj.

The Price of Ingenuity#699.src: Those ones are a little boring, but. But! I told Pa about it, and he offered to read them out for me, just like he used to!! He's had to help with Ma's workload, so he hasn't done that in a while.
The Price of Ingenuity#699.dst: Esos son un poco aburridos, pero. ¡Pero! Se lo conté a papá y se ofreció a leérmelos en voz alta, ¡¡como hacía antes!! Ha tenido que ayudar con el trabajo de mamá, así que hacía tiempo que no lo hacía.

The Price of Ingenuity#700.src: So... that's nice. I guess. Makes it more fun to read that stuff when I'm doing it with him! I didn't ever realize he knew so much about this stuff!!
The Price of Ingenuity#700.dst: Así que... qué bien. Supongo. ¡Es más divertido leer esas cosas cuando lo hago con él! ¡¡Nunca me había dado cuenta de que sabía tanto de esto!!

The Price of Ingenuity#701.src: I also got Uncle T to give me some of HIS books! The ones about inventing, and engineering. They were a fun read! Even though I knew most of it already...
The Price of Ingenuity#701.dst: ¡También conseguí que el tío T me diera algunos de SUS libros! Los de inventos e ingeniería. ¡Fueron divertidos de leer! Aunque ya me sabía casi todo...

The Price of Ingenuity#702.src: But I know what I'm doing now! And when I have free time... I'll make the super-est duper-est farmer in the WORLD!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#702.dst: ¡Pero ahora sé lo que hago! Y cuando tenga tiempo libre... ¡¡¡haré el granjero más súper mega del MUNDO!!!

The Price of Ingenuity#703.src: It's going to be AWESOME! We'll get to see the Queen, and the Sovereign... and yeah, okay, maybe the official celebration's bo-ring...
The Price of Ingenuity#703.dst: ¡Va a ser ALUCINANTE! Veremos a la Reina, y al Soberano... y sí, vale, quizá la celebración oficial sea un ro-llo...

The Price of Ingenuity#704.src: BUT. But! Everyone gets the day off work!! And Uncle T always brings back good food, and Ma cooks it up with her own special recipe, and Pa gets me and Fiona gifts... it's the BEST!!
The Price of Ingenuity#704.dst: PERO. ¡Pero! ¡¡Todo el mundo tiene el día libre!! Y el tío T siempre trae buena comida, y mamá la cocina con su receta especial, y papá nos hace regalos a Fiona y a mí... ¡¡es lo MEJOR!!

The Price of Ingenuity#705.src: AND! And because of the super duper farmer, I've had so much free time!! It works GREAT!! Okay, maybe it took a lot of tries to get perfect... but it works NOW, so. That means it's good!!
The Price of Ingenuity#705.dst: ¡Y! ¡¡Y gracias al súper mega granjero, he tenido muchísimo tiempo libre!! ¡¡Funciona GENIAL!! Vale, quizá hicieron falta muchos intentos para dejarlo perfecto... pero AHORA funciona, así que. ¡¡Eso significa que es bueno!!

The Price of Ingenuity#706.src: Don't tell Ma or Pa... but Fiona and I are gonna stay up all night!! We're gonna play with our dolls, and TALK, and HANG OUT... it's gonna be awesome!
The Price of Ingenuity#706.dst: No se lo digas a mamá ni a papá... ¡¡pero Fiona y yo vamos a pasar la noche en vela!! Vamos a jugar con nuestros muñecos, y a HABLAR, y a PASAR EL RATO... ¡va a ser genial!

The Price of Ingenuity#707.src: Flowers and Daruma are BEST FRIENDS, just like us!
The Price of Ingenuity#707.dst: ¡Flowers y Daruma son MEJORES AMIGOS, igual que nosotras!

The Price of Ingenuity#708.src: I didn't catch his name... some kinda general or something, I don't know- but he wanted to talk to Ma and Pa.
The Price of Ingenuity#708.dst: No me enteré de su nombre... una especie de general o algo así, no sé- pero quería hablar con mamá y papá.

The Price of Ingenuity#709.src: They told me to stay in my room, but the walls are super thin, so I tried listening in! Still couldn't hear much... but I heard him mention my super duper farmer!
The Price of Ingenuity#709.dst: Me dijeron que me quedara en mi cuarto, pero las paredes son súper finas, ¡así que intenté escuchar! Aun así no oí mucho... ¡pero le oí mencionar mi súper mega granjero!

The Price of Ingenuity#710.src: I thought I might be in trouble, cause why else would it be a secret?
The Price of Ingenuity#710.dst: Pensé que igual me había metido en un lío, porque si no, ¿por qué iba a ser un secreto?

The Price of Ingenuity#711.src: But! But but but, when they all came out, Uncle T said I'd get to be his ASSISTANT!!! No more farm work!!!! And I get to make cool stuff??? Heck yeah!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#711.dst: ¡Pero! Pero pero pero, cuando salieron todos, ¡¡¡el tío T dijo que podía ser su AYUDANTE!!! ¡¡¡¡Se acabó el trabajo en el campo!!!! ¿¿¿Y puedo hacer cosas guays??? ¡¡¡Pues claro que sí!!!

The Price of Ingenuity#712.src: Still... dunno why, but Ma looked a little sad. Maybe she's still not feeling well? I really hope she gets better soon.
The Price of Ingenuity#712.dst: Aun así... no sé por qué, pero mamá parecía un poco triste. ¿Quizá todavía no se encuentra bien? Espero de verdad que se mejore pronto.

The Price of Ingenuity#713.src: I got to meet Sovereign Amastli for the first time EVER. Well, okay, sometimes I saw him during the festivals... but STILL!! It's different when I get to TALK to him... duh...
